title: GARL: Game-Theoretic Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Agent Strategic Prioritisation
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems are increasingly used for strategic decision-making tasks. In such settings, performance depends not only on individual model capabilities, but also on the policies by which agents interact and adapt. Multi-agent reinforcement learning can optimise these interaction policies, but its reward design often remains task-specific and weakly grounded in interaction structure. To address this gap, we propose GARL, a GAme-theoretic Reinforcement Learning framework for multi-agent strategic prioritisation. GARL formalises strategic prioritisation as a two-stage game: competing agents first allocate strategic resources over a shared candidate set, and a higher-level arbiter then produces the final ranking. The resulting game-theoretic utilities are converted into role-specific reinforcement signals, allowing policy optimisation to be guided by structured interaction. We instantiate GARL on issues-in-dispute ranking, where the goal is to prioritise core issues in legal proceedings. Experiments show that GARL improves ranking performance, enables small open-source LLMs to become competitive with a strong closed-source LLM under the same candidate-ranking setting, and yields gains in legal-domain competence and broader strategic decision-making. Overall, GARL demonstrates how game-theoretic interaction structure can be turned into reinforcement-learning objectives, providing a principled approach to policy optimisation in multi-agent strategic prioritisation.

AI.tldr: GARL提出了一种博弈论强化学习框架，将多智能体战略优先级排序问题形式化为两阶段博弈（议程分配+仲裁），并将博弈效用转化为角色特定的强化信号，在法律争议焦点排序任务上验证了其有效性，使小型开源LLM可媲美强闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统在战略决策中，MARL的奖励设计往往任务特定且缺乏交互结构基础。论文旨在通过博弈论结构为多智能体战略优先级排序中的策略优化提供原则性的强化学习信号。
AI.method: 两阶段博弈形式化：1) 议程分配博弈——竞争智能体（原告/被告）共享候选集分配战略资源以塑造显著性分布；2) 仲裁博弈——上级仲裁者（法官）基于诱导的显著性状态产生最终排序。将角色博弈效用转换为token级优势（REINFORCE++），采用交替策略优化，共享分配者模型与独立仲裁者模型，通过KL阈值控制阶段切换。
AI.result: 在LexIssue争议焦点排序任务上，GARL显著提升Qwen3-4B/8B性能（8B mAP从85.22提升至90.43，超越同条件下GPT-4），且具有域外泛化能力；在LawBench上J模型带来适度提升；在GameBench上PD和J模型均改善战略决策能力。训练动力学显示奖励变化趋于零、P-D损失比趋近-1，表明博弈趋于均衡稳定。
AI.conclusion: GARL证明博弈论交互结构可操作化为任务驱动的强化信号，为多智能体战略优先级排序提供了原则性的策略优化方法，并可推广至政策优先级、投资分配等其他战略决策场景。

title: Depth-Attention: Cross-Layer Value Mixing for Language Models
summary: Self-attention selects information freely across the sequence, but across depth, Transformers merely add each layer's output to the residual stream, so later layers cannot selectively reuse earlier-layer representations. Recent cross-layer methods improve this flow but operate on hidden states outside attention, adding state beyond the key-value cache at inference--a cost that becomes increasingly salient as modern LLMs compress the cache with grouped-query and multi-head latent attention. We introduce Depth-Attention, which performs this selection inside the attention module itself: before a layer attends over the sequence, its query attends over the keys of earlier layers at the same token position and mixes their values into the value that self-attention then reads. Because Depth-Attention reuses the standard attention queries, keys, and value-cache slots, storing depth-mixed values in place of the original values, it adds no parameters and introduces no persistent inference state beyond the standard key-value cache--the same cache size as a vanilla decoder and less than hidden-state-based cross-layer methods. On Qwen3-style decoders at 1.5B and 3B parameters, Depth-Attention attains the lowest perplexity and the highest average downstream accuracy, improving over the vanilla Transformer by up to 2.3 accuracy points and surpassing strong cross-layer baselines in perplexity and average accuracy, while adding under 0.01% extra arithmetic FLOPs and no additional persistent inference state. The gains hold from 360M to 3B parameters and extend to looped Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Depth-Attention，一种在注意力模块内部沿深度方向对跨层 value 状态进行选择性混合的机制。通过让当前层 query 沿深度维度对同位置早层 key 做注意力并混合其 value，Depth-Attention 在不增加参数量、不扩大 KV 缓存（替换 V-cache 槽位）的前提下，为 Transformer 解码器引入了内容自适应的跨层信息复用。在 Qwen3 架构 1.5B/3B 模型上以 32B tokens 训练，下游平均准确率最高提升 2.3 点，困惑度与平均准确率均优于 mHC、Attention Residuals、DenseFormer 等强基线，额外 FLOPs 不足 0.01%，且 128K 上下文预fill 无任何持久化额外显存。
AI.motivation: 标准 Transformer 解码器在序列维度上靠自注意力实现选择性信息路由，但在深度维度上仅靠残差连接将所有早层信息压缩进单一隐藏状态，深层无法按需选择性地访问某一具体早层表示。现有跨层方法（Hyper-Connections、mHC、DenseFormer、Attention Residuals 等）虽改进了深度信息流，但都作用在隐藏状态上，需要在 KV 缓存之外额外汇聚或保留早层隐藏表示，引入了与 KV 缓存并行的额外推理状态；而在 GQA、MLA 越来越压缩 KV 缓存的趋势下，这种额外开销的相对成本愈发突出。核心问题：能否在不引入任何额外持久推理状态的前提下，让层间实现内容自适应的跨层信息复用。
AI.method: Depth-Attention 将跨层选择搬入注意力模块内部。在第 ℓ 层、对位置 t 的 token，先用当前层 query q_t^ℓ 沿深度维度对同位置 {ℓ, ℓ−s, ℓ−2s, …} 等稀疏跨层 key k_j^t 计算 softmax 深度注意力权重 α_{ℓ,j}^t，再用这些权重把当前层 value v_t^ℓ 与早层已深度混合过的 value ṽ_j^t 重新组合成新的 value ṽ_t^ℓ；之后该层仍以原始 Q^ℓ、K^ℓ 及因果掩码对 ṽ^ℓ 做标准因果自注意力。推理时 ṽ^ℓ 直接替换 V-cache 槽位中的 V^ℓ（同形状），不增加参数量与持久缓存。实现上采用：1) 步长 s = L/2 的稀疏深度源以限制源集规模与跨设备通信；2) GQA 下对每组 g 个 query 取平均，使深度注意力在 KV 头分辨率上运行，进一步降低开销。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3 风格 1.5B/3B 解码器、以 Pile 上 32B token 从零训练的设定下，Depth-Attention 在两种规模、零样本与五样本设置下均取得最低验证困惑度与最高下游平均准确率（1.5B zero-shot 53.60%、3B zero-shot 55.69%、3B five-shot 56.17%），相对 vanilla Transformer 平均准确率最高提升 2.3 点，并优于 mHC、Attention Residuals、DenseFormer。效率上，3B 模型额外 FLOPs 仅 2.4×10^5（约为 2N 的 0.004%），额外激活 I/O 仅 282 KiB，128K 预fill 额外持久显存为 0 GiB（基线 DenseFormer 24 GiB、Attention Residuals 4 GiB、mHC 1.5 GiB）；统一 PyTorch 实现下训练壁钟仅 +9.1%/+11.2%，推理时间 +1.18%、峰值显存不变。消融显示 s = L/2 的稀疏度、每头 softmax 混合、仅更新 V 是最优组合；可视化表明深层确实给中间层源赋予了显著权重，方法未退化为 vanilla。缩放实验覆盖 360M–3B 一致带来验证 loss 下降，并能迁移到三层循环的 looped Transformer（500M 验证 loss 2.208→2.194）。
AI.conclusion: Depth-Attention 把跨层信息复用变成“注意力原生”的操作：复用现有 Q/K 与 V-cache 槽位，零额外参数、零额外持久推理状态，保持因果注意力模式不变，同时在困惑度与下游准确率上稳定优于 vanilla Transformer 及 mHC、Attention Residuals、DenseFormer 等强跨层基线，且 FLOPs、显存、壁钟开销均远低于这些基线。其收益在 360M–3B 范围内随规模保持，并可扩展到以参数共享实现深度的 looped Transformer。作者指出局限在于：当前未融合进注意力核导致实测壁钟高于理论 FLOPs 提示值；验证仅到 3B 参数、32B 训练 token，更大尺度尚待确认；深度源选择仍用固定步长，可学习的源选择与更丰富的跨层交互是未来方向。

title: TaDA: Calibrated Probe Gating for Task-Domain LoRA Merging
summary: Combining a task LoRA adapter with a domain LoRA adapter into a single unified model is a practical yet largely unexplored challenge. Existing methods treat both adapters as symmetric peers, applying uniform weights across all layers. We argue that task and domain adapters exhibit a consistent depth-dependent asymmetry across transformer architectures. Domain dominance increases with layer depth, while shallower layers retain stronger task-relevant signals. Motivated by this observation, we propose $\textbf{TaDA}$ ($\textbf{Ta}$sk-$\textbf{D}$omain LoR$\textbf{A}$ Merging), a training-free algorithm that exploits this structure through calibrated probe-guided per-layer gating and per-component subspace-aware merging. The gating assigns individual weights per layer and projection type using a probe signal proved invariant to adapter weight magnitude. The merging discards conflicting singular directions before combining the remaining components. $\textbf{TaDA}$ produces a standard rank-$r$ LoRA adapter with zero inference overhead. On six scientific QA benchmarks with Llama-2-7B, TaDA achieves an average accuracy of 0.452, outperforming DARE-TIES by +3.6 percentage points and obtaining the best result on all six benchmarks. On six image classification benchmarks with ViT-L/16, TaDA reaches 85.9\% average accuracy, improving over the strongest merging baseline while leading in three of the six individual benchmarks.

AI.tldr: TaDA是一种无需训练的任务-领域LoRA适配器合并算法，通过校准探针引导的逐层门控和子空间感知的逐分量合并，解决现有方法将任务和领域适配器视为对称对等体而忽略其深度依赖性差异的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的LoRA适配器合并方法（如Linear、TIES、DARE、Task Arithmetic等）将任务适配器和领域适配器视为对称对等体，在所有层上应用统一权重。作者发现任务和领域适配器在Transformer架构中存在一致的深度依赖性不对称性：领域主导性随层深度增加而增强，而较浅层保留更强的任务相关信号。统一权重合并会给浅层的领域适配器过多影响（损害任务格式），给深层的领域适配器过少影响（稀释领域知识）。
AI.method: TaDA包含两个核心创新：(1) 校准探针引导的逐层门控——构建领域探针集（如PubMed）和通用探针集（如Wikipedia），通过计算激活范数比值得到校准领域相关性分数s^ℓ，该分数被证明对适配器权重幅度的标量缩放具有不变性（命题1）；使用模块类型感知的阈值τ_m（q/k=1.0, v=1.2, o=1.5）通过sigmoid函数计算逐层逐模块的任务权重α。(2) 逐分量子空间感知合并——对两个适配器进行SVD分解，联合U+V重叠过滤（阈值δ=0.10）丢弃输入和输出特征空间中方向冲突的奇异分量，对保留的分量使用分量级权重合并，最终通过SVD截断重构为标准rank-r LoRA。生成的合并适配器推理时零开销。
AI.result: 在语言任务（Llama-2-7B）和视觉任务（ViT-L/16）共12个基准上评估：语言方面，6个科学QA基准平均准确率0.452，超过DARE-TIES +3.6个百分点，在全部6个基准上取得最佳结果（包括MedMCQA 0.344、MedQA 0.392、SciQ 0.836、ARC-C 0.374、MMLU-CS 0.380、MMLU-Science 0.396）；视觉方面，6个图像分类基准平均准确率85.9%，超过最强基线DARE-TIES（85.6%），在4/6基准上领先。消融实验表明探针引导门控是性能的主要驱动力（移除后下降1.0-1.2pp），模块类型τ和子空间过滤提供互补改进。跨模态分析证实了深度依赖不对称性在语言和视觉架构中的一致性。一次性合并开销约31分钟（A100 GPU），推理延迟与单个LoRA相同。
AI.conclusion: TaDA通过利用Transformer中任务和领域适配器之间的深度依赖激活不对称性，实现了训练免费的LoRA合并，在保留任务格式能力的同时融入领域知识。该方法在语言和视觉两种模态、12个基准上均优于现有合并基线，验证了探针引导门控作为架构无关机制的有效性。未来工作方向包括扩展到两个以上适配器的合并，以及验证该方法在prefix tuning等其他适配器家族上的适用性。

title: Imbuing Large Language Models with Bidirectional Logic for Robust Chain Repair
summary: Autoregressive chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in large language models (LLMs) is fundamentally forward-directed: each step conditions only on prior tokens. This unidirectional inductive bias renders even capable models susceptible to error snowballing, wherein a single logical or arithmetic mistake in an early step irreversibly corrupts the entire reasoning chain. We introduce Teleological Reasoning Infilling (\TRI{}), a training framework that endows decoder-only transformers with a native \emph{goal-conditioned bridging} capability. The key insight is to reframe erroneous reasoning segments as fill-in-the-middle (FIM) tasks: given a verified prefix premise $P$, a verified downstream milestone $S$, and the original query $Q$, the model must synthesise the logical bridge $M$ that connects $P$ to $S$ rigorously and completely. To achieve this with standard causal architectures, we introduce a Prefix-Suffix-Middle (PSM) sequence rearrangement with three non-overlapping sentinel tokens, enabling $M$ to attend to both $P$ and $S$ without any structural modification to the self-attention mechanism. Training proceeds in two stages: (i) Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on symbolically verified $(P, S, M)$ triples extracted from formal mathematics corpora, and (ii) Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) with a deterministic symbolic verifier (Lean 4 / Python) as the sole reward oracle, eliminating LLM-judge sycophancy. At inference, TRI operates as a surgical repair module within a dual-system loop: a causal draft model generates an initial trace, the verifier pinpoints failures, and TRI infills only the damaged segment, leaving verified sections intact. Comprehensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that TRI achieves state-of-the-art performance across all tasks, while reducing per-problem token expenditure by 31.2%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Teleological Reasoning Infilling (TRI)框架，通过Prefix-Suffix-Middle (PSM)序列重排和三个哨兵token，使标准的decoder-only Transformer能在不修改自注意力机制的前提下，同时对验证前提P和未来里程碑S进行条件化桥接生成M。两阶段训练（SFT + 符号验证器驱动的DPO）配合双系统推理修复循环，在MATH、HumanEval-Fix和Lean-Workbook三个基准上达到SOTA，同时减少31.2%的token消耗。
AI.motivation: 自回归CoT推理的单向归纳偏置导致"错误滚雪球"问题：早期步骤的逻辑或算术错误会不可逆地污染整条推理链。现有方法（CoT-SC、ToT、Reason from Future等）均为推理时的包装策略，未改变模型的生成机制本身；同时FIM仅被用于粒度细化而非逻辑修复，且缺乏符号验证锚点。需要一种能原生利用双向逻辑约束进行推理链修复的训练-推理一体化框架。
AI.method: 核心是PSM序列架构：将输入重排为[Q ⊕ ⟨premise⟩ ⊕ P ⊕ ⟨milestone⟩ ⊕ S ⊕ ⟨bridge⟩ ⊕ M]，使M在因果掩码下能同时attend到P和S。训练分两阶段：（1）SFT在≈780k来自MATH训练集和Lean-Workbook的符号验证(Q,P,S,M)四元组上，gap span限制为[2,6]步；（2）DPO使用Lean 4/Python符号验证器作为奖励oracle，生成≈312k偏好对，弃用LLM-judge以避免谄媚。推理时采用双系统修复循环：因果draft模型生成初稿→验证器定位首个失败位置→ExtractMilestone前向扫描W_max=8步找到首个可验证里程碑→TRI在PSM格式下生成桥接M→重验，迭代至通过或预算耗尽。理论方面证明了Topological Consistency性质（验证概率随N→∞指数集中）和PSM通用近似性定理。
AI.result: 在三个基准上均达SOTA且显著降低token消耗：MATH L1-L5准确率97.6/95.4/89.3/74.7/53.7%，相对最佳基线+0.8至+6.4 pp（难度越高提升越大）；HumanEval-Fix Pass@1达74.9%（+8.1 pp）；Lean-Workbook PCR达57.1%（+5.9 pp，超越InternLM-StepProver CoT-SC k=8）；平均token消耗1268/题，减少31.2%。效率鲁棒性分析显示：在B=1000紧预算下MATH L5领先+10.2 pp；50%故障率下领先+8.4 pp。消融实验揭示符号验证器是最关键组件（去掉后MATH L5下降7.5 pp），首个可验证里程碑是最优S选择策略。Repair成功率73.8%，平均仅需1.2次修复调用。
AI.conclusion: TRI通过PSM序列重排+SFT+DPO+符号验证器四要素的有机结合，在不修改自注意力机制的前提下为decoder-only Transformer赋予了真正的双向目标条件化推理能力，证明了"外科手术式"链修复策略在准确性和计算效率上均优于穷举式搜索和集成投票。理论分析（Topological Consistency + PSM通用近似）为方法提供了渐近保证。代码-数学-形式证明三领域的迁移成功表明该框架的通用性，方向为后续双向推理研究和测试时计算的高效利用开辟了新路径。

title: Boosting Self-Consistency with Ranking
comment: 16 pages, 13 figures, accepted at ACL Student Research Workshop 2026
summary: Self-consistency improves large language models by sampling multiple reasoning paths and selecting the most frequent answer, but majority voting often fails to recover correct answers that are already present among the samples. We address this limitation with Ranking-Improved Self-Consistency (RISC), which reformulates answer selection in self-consistency as a ranking problem. Instead of relying on a single uncertainty or confidence signal, RISC uses a lightweight LambdaRank model to score candidate answers with five carefully designed features that capture answer frequency, semantic centrality, and reasoning-trace consistency. We evaluate RISC on three datasets under a range of test-time budgets. Across datasets, RISC consistently achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than standard self-consistency and strong baselines, with particularly large gains on question answering benchmarks. Further analysis shows that the proposed features are individually useful and, more importantly, complementary, highlighting the value of learning to combine multiple informative signals for test-time answer selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RISC（Ranking-Improved Self-Consistency），将自一致性解码中的答案选择重新建模为排序问题，使用基于五个可解释特征的轻量级 LambdaRank 模型进行候选答案排序，在三个基准上以更少的推理成本实现优于多数投票和强基线（如 CISC、Stable Rank、ReASC）的准确率。
AI.motivation: 自一致性（Self-Consistency）通过多数投票选择答案，但当正确答案已存在于采样候选中时，多数投票常常无法恢复它——存在显著的"oracle gap"。现有改进方法（如 CISC 基于语言不确定性、Stable Rank 基于内部几何结构）依赖单一手工信号，难以泛化到不同任务。受学习排序（Learning-to-Rank）启发，作者主张将答案选择视为相对排序问题，通过学习组合多个互补信号来更可靠地识别正确答案。
AI.method: RISC 将自一致性形式化为查询相关的排序任务：对同一 prompt 采样的 N 个候选进行相对打分，最终选取得分最高者。使用 LightGBM LambdaRank 模型，以 NDCG 作为列表级目标进行训练。设计了五个可解释特征：(1) Answer Length（答案字符长度）；(2) Ratio to Best（候选答案频次与最高频次之比）；(3) Distance to Answer Centroid（候选答案嵌入到加权答案质心的欧氏距离）；(4) Worst-Step Coherence（同一最终答案的所有推理链中，各步嵌入与链内质心余弦相似度的最小值的平均）；(5) Shared Checkpoints Count（具有相同最终答案的不同推理链之间在相近深度上语义匹配的中间前缀数量）。所有嵌入由 MiniLM 句子编码器生成。模型在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（额外测试 Olmo-3-7B-Instruct）上对 PopQA、HotpotQA、MATH500 三个数据集进行评估。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，RISC 在所有数据集和 LLM 调用预算下持续优于 Self-Consistency、Stable Rank、ReASC 和 CISC 基线。在 QA 数据集上优势尤为显著：例如在 PopQA 上仅用 18 个样本即超过自一致性 99 个样本的准确率。表 1 显示在 PopQA 和 HotpotQA 上，成本降低达 61–71%，准确率提升 4.7–8%，且常超过 SC 的最大准确率（"headroom over maximum"）。在 MATH500 上提升较小但仍具竞争力。消融实验显示五个特征在 QA 上各自有用且互补（双特征消融降幅超过单特征降幅之和），SHAP 分析揭示了非加性的特征交互。跨域迁移在 QA 间表现稳健，但迁移到 MATH500 显著下降。
AI.conclusion: RISC 将自一致性重新定义为排序问题，证明了通过轻量级学习排序模型组合多个互补信号比单一手工信号更有效。该方法在 QA 任务上带来显著的成本-准确率权衡改善，在数学推理上提升有限但仍有竞争力。论文公开了代码。研究表明学习组合多种信息性信号是测试时答案选择的有前景方向，仍存在与 oracle 选择之间的差距，是未来改进空间。

title: Light or Full Verb? A Minimal-Pair Dataset for Probing Phraseological Competence in Language Models
summary: Frequent English verbs such as 'have' and 'make' can function either as collocates in light-verb constructions or as full lexical predicates, as in 'make a decision' vs. 'make a cake'. Whether language models represent this distinction remains unclear. We introduce a large-scale controlled dataset of minimally varying English sentence series in which the same context contains the same verb in light-verb and full-verb uses. Two probing experiments show that language models differentiate between these uses even in minimal contexts and exhibit separable patterns across object types. We release the dataset, generation code, and materials as a reusable resource. The framework supports extensions to broader contexts, additional verbs, and other languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个大规模受控的英语最小对数据集，用于探测语言模型对轻动词构造（LVCs，如"make a decision"）与完全动词用法（如"make a cake"）之间区别的表征能力。通过对Gemma 3-270M的惊奇度（surprisal）探测和上下文嵌入聚类分析两项实验，证明语言模型即使在最小语境下也能区分这两种用法，并在宾语表征空间中呈现出可分离的模式。
AI.motivation: 轻动词构造（LVCs）在理论语言学、词汇语义学和短语学中长期受到关注，但作为语言模型诊断材料的潜力尚未充分开发。现有计算研究多将LVC视为识别/分类问题（即判断给定动名组合是否为LVC），而非探测模型在受控条件下是否能区分同一动词的轻动词用法与完全动词用法。因此需要一种新的基准测试方法来揭示模型是否真正编码了这种词汇-功能对比，而非仅依赖分布关联或词汇记忆。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1) 数据集构建——基于CollFrEn选取五个高频英语轻动词（make, take, give, have, receive），为每个动词选取20-40个LVC搭配和等量的具体名词宾语，构建主动/被动、过去/将来/过去完成时等变化语境，生成约47,600个句子的最小对系列；(2) 惊奇度探测——按SyntaxGym框架，在主动句中以宾语名词为关键区域，在被动句中以动词为关键区域，计算token级惊奇度并比较LVC与完全动词条件的差异；(3) 上下文嵌入分析——提取宾语名词短语的隐藏状态，进行逐层表征和层间变化（Δl）的KMeans聚类分析，并通过PCA降维可视化检验LVC/完全动词条件的可分性。使用模型为google/gemma-3-270m。
AI.result: 主动句宾语惊奇度实验中，除receive外，所有轻动词条件下的关键区域惊奇度均低于完全动词对照条件，说明模型为LVC兼容的名词基础分配了更高的上下文概率。被动句中，谓词性名词基础使其对应的轻动词更具可预测性，其中make的惊奇度最低，表现出最强的支持动词期望。上下文嵌入分析显示，KMeans聚类纯度高，尤其在Δl的较高层中，LVC与完全动词条件得到清晰分离；layer 15的PCA投影示例中聚类纯度达到1.00，表明该对比在模型内部表征几何中亦有体现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明Gemma 3-270M对LVC具有敏感性：LVC兼容名词基础在轻动词后惊奇度更低，谓词性名词基础使其对应支持动词在被动句中更可预测。宾语表征在模型内部分离LVC与完全动词条件，反映了该对比不仅存在于token级预测概率中，也存在于上下文表征空间中。数据集设计为可扩展资源，支持未来扩展至更多动词、更广语境、其他语言及心理语言学测试。局限在于动词和构式范围有限、语境为半控制状态、分析仅限英语。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models in Dynamic Clinical Decision-Making with Standardized Patient Cases
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as clinical agents, yet static, single-turn benchmarks cannot capture how a model dynamically delivers care across an encounter: gathering information, planning treatment, and adapting longitudinal management across successive patient states. Medical education has long addressed an analogous challenge through standardized patients (SPs): trained actors who consistently portray clinical cases, enabling realistic practice and objective, scripted assessment. Here we introduce MedSP1000, an SP-derived interactive benchmark for clinical-agent evaluation, including 1,638 SP cases with 24,602 trajectory-level peer-reviewed rubrics. MedSP1000 converts peer-reviewed SP teaching cases into executable scenarios with defined SP case scripts, clinical environment contexts, and human-validated structured rubric. In each simulation evaluation run, a clinical agent interacts in closed loop with a patient agent and an environment controller, and its behaviour is scored throughout the encounter against expert criteria specified in the original materials. Applying MedSP1000 to a range of general-purpose and medically specialized LLMs, we find that performance on static benchmarks does not reliably translate to such educational scenarios. The best-performing model, GPT-5.5, completes only 60.4% of expert-defined rubric items, whereas the strongest medically specialized model reaches 40.0%; increasing test-time compute produces no measurable gain. These results suggest that current LLMs, including agentic systems tuned for medicine, are not yet reliable enough to be safely integrated into actual clinical practice. More broadly, MedSP1000 shows how process-level, SP-style evaluation can reveal clinically relevant failure modes that single-turn benchmarks miss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MedSP1000，一个源自标准化患者（SP）的交互式临床智能体评测基准。该基准将同行评审的 SP 教学病例转化为可执行的交互式临床场景，包含 1,638 个病例和 24,602 条轨迹级评分标准，用于对 LLM 驱动的临床智能体进行多轮、过程化的闭环评估。实验表明，主流及医学专用 LLM 在该基准上的表现远低于静态基准预期，最佳模型仅完成 60.4% 的专家评分项，揭示了当前 LLM 尚不足以安全应用于真实临床实践。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 临床能力评测多为静态、单轮问答式基准（如医学考试题），无法反映模型在真实临床问诊中动态采集信息、制定治疗方案、并随患者状态演变进行纵向管理的能力。医学教育中长期使用"标准化患者"（SP）进行训练与评估，作者希望借鉴这一范式，弥补静态基准与真实临床交互之间的评测鸿沟。
AI.method: MedSP1000 将同行评审的 SP 教学病例转化为可执行评测场景，包含三个组件：(1) SP 病例脚本，定义患者主诉、病史与角色行为；(2) 临床环境上下文；(3) 经人类验证的结构化评分细则。评测时，临床智能体与"患者智能体"及"环境控制器"构成闭环进行多轮交互，其全过程行为依据原始材料的专家标准进行评分。共构建 1,638 个病例、24,602 条轨迹级评分项，并据此对多款通用与医学专用 LLM 进行系统评测。
AI.result: 在 MedSP1000 上，静态基准上的高性能未能可靠迁移到该交互式评测。表现最佳的模型（GPT-5.5）仅完成 60.4% 的专家评分项；最强的医学专用模型仅达 40.0%。此外，增加测试时计算量（如更长推理）未带来可观测的收益，表明当前模型并非因推理资源不足而受限。
AI.conclusion: 当前包括医学专用智能体系统在内的 LLM 仍不足以可靠、安全地集成到真实临床实践中。MedSP1000 展示了基于过程、SP 风格的评估方式能够揭示单轮静态基准所遗漏的临床相关失败模式，为临床智能体的能力评测提供了更具生态效度的新范式。

title: Self-Evaluation Is Already There: Eliciting Latent Judge Calibration in Base LLMs with Minimal Data
summary: Large language models are increasingly evaluated by other models, raising a natural question: can a model predict how a judge will score its own output? We find that the ability is largely present before any targeted training: prompted few-shot, a base model already predicts an external judge's multi-attribute quality scores on open-ended responses well above chance across three benchmarks. We introduce Self-Evaluation Elicitation (SEE), a method that surfaces this latent ability through a short cycle comprising a calibration-coupled reinforcement learning phase that improves the answer and predicts the judge, followed by a masked distillation phase that sharpens the prediction while leaving the answer untouched. From 160 unique examples, roughly 31x fewer than a reinforcement learning baseline, SEE improves held-out calibration across three benchmarks while preserving answer quality. The elicited self-evaluation is sharply localized within the model's own token distribution and stable across judges it was never trained against, indicating a transferable notion of quality rather than a single judge's preference. These results reframe judge-aligned self-evaluation as a problem of elicitation rather than acquisition.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"自评抽取"（Self-Evaluation Elicitation, SEE）方法,通过少量数据（仅160个独特样本）即可激发基座LLM预测外部评判器对其自身输出打分的能力。核心发现是：基座模型在专门训练前已具备此能力（校准度0.5~0.70，远高于随机水平），SEE通过"校准耦合强化学习"+"掩码评判器蒸馏"两阶段交替循环,仅用比基线少31倍的数据即可在三个开放性基准上提升校准度并保持答案质量,且对未见过的评判器也保持稳定。论文将自评问题重新定位为"激发"而非"习得"。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地由其他模型评判,一个自然的问题浮现：模型能否预测评判器将如何给自己的输出打分？这种能力对模型自重排、延迟判断、升级难提示等场景都很有价值。已有研究多聚焦于可验证任务（数学/推理/代码）的标量正确性预测,而对开放性任务下多属性质量评分的预测以及基座模型在专门训练前已具备多少此能力尚不清楚。
AI.method: SEE包含两阶段交替循环:（1）校准耦合强化学习（GRPO）——策略生成答案+自评块[SELF_EVAL],奖励由质量项（3个评估属性均分）与校准项（5个属性的非线性MAE,γ=2)组成,格式错误受固定惩罚;（2）掩码评判器蒸馏——用第一阶段回放缓冲区中的rollout,自评块替换为评判器真实分数,采用5×5分层轮询采样保证分数覆盖,损失仅施加于自评标记而不影响答案部分。15个循环,共160个独特样本,2,400次样本遍历;基线为Adapted RLCR（仅RL阶段,无蒸馏,约5,000样本）。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base上:（1）基座模型few-shot即可达校准度0.50~0.70,Top-5准确率77.07%;（2）SEE在HelpSteer2验证集上校准度从0.632→0.731,胜过Adapted RLCR的0.675;（3）在LC AlpacaEval 2.0、Arena-Hard-Auto v2.0、WildBench v2上SEE全面领先,尤以WildBench校准度提升最大（0.504→0.609);（4）仅用160个独特样本即达基线最终成绩,样本-遍历数比基线少12倍,独特样本少31倍;（5）换用Claude Sonnet 4.6和Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite等未见评判器重打分,排序仍保持SEE>Adapted RLCR>基座;（6）Top-5准确率提升至0.88~0.91,自评分数集中在模型分布头部。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出三个核心结论:（1）将自评重新定位为"激发"而非"习得"问题——基座模型已具备评判器对齐的多属性质量评估表征,后训练的作用是将其引出而非植入;（2）SEE提供一种轻量级"循环RL+SFT"程序设计原则——对自评标记与答案标记施加分离监督,二者可并行改进而不互相干扰;（3）激发的自评具有迁移性,既跨评判器稳定,又定位于模型自身token分布的顶部,具备实际应用价值（如自重排、自延迟、升级调用）。研究受限于单一基座模型与单一LLM评判器家族,未涉及人类评估。

title: Disentangling Answer Engine Optimization from Platform Growth: A Log-Based Natural Experiment on ChatGPT Referral Traffic
summary: Large language model (LLM) "answer engines" such as ChatGPT now send measurable referral traffic to the open web, and a practice analogous to search engine optimization, here called Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), has emerged. Public AEO success stories typically quote large raw growth multiples, but raw referral growth is confounded by the rapid platform-level growth of the answer engines themselves. We report a longitudinal field study on a single high-traffic domain ( this http URL ) whose corpus of hundreds of thousands of YouTube question-and-answer pages received a defined bundle of AEO interventions in January 2026 (detailed in Section 4). Because the interventions were concentrated on one subset of the site, the untreated remainder of the same domain acts as a contemporaneous control that absorbs the platform tailwind. Using first-party analytics and server logs rather than probabilistic third-party estimators, we find: (1) raw growth is dominated by the platform tailwind: on monthly aggregates total ChatGPT referrals grew 5.7x while untreated pages on the same domain grew 3.5x over the same window; (2) an interrupted time-series model on the weekly treated/control ratio estimates a discrete, intervention-aligned level increase of 1.82x (95% CI 1.31-2.54, HAC p=0.001), robust across engagement-filtered traffic (2.27x) and alternative specifications; (3) however, a conservative placebo-in-time permutation test yields p=0.16, so the effect is suggestive, not conclusive, given a short and noisy pre-period; and (4) Google organic clicks to treated pages did not fall beyond the ambient site-wide trend and indexation was preserved, consistent with the SEO-protection rule. The methodological message, separating treatment from platform tailwind with an on-domain control, matters more than any single multiple, and implies that headline AEO multiples substantially overstate causal effect.

AI.tldr: 本文对单一高流量域名 glasp.co 上的 AEO（Answer Engine Optimization，答案引擎优化）干预效果进行自然实验研究，核心方法是利用同一域内未受干预的页面作为同期对照组，从平台整体增长中分离出真正的干预效应。研究发现：原始推荐流量增长 5.7× 中约 3.5× 来自 ChatGPT 平台自身的增长尾部；通过中断时间序列模型估计的干预引起的离散水平跃升约为 1.82×（稳健性检验下 1.8–2.3×），但安慰剂检验 p=0.16，效应仅是"暗示性"而非定论；同时 SEO 未受明显损害。
AI.motivation: 当前公开的 AEO 成功案例普遍引用原始推荐流量增长倍数（如 5×、10×），但这些数字被 LLM 答案引擎自身爆发式增长所污染，无法区分是优化措施的因果效应还是平台整体扩张的"顺风"。论文的核心动机是提出一个低成本、可复现的测量方法，将干预效应从平台增长中剥离出来，并给出一个诚实的效应估计。
AI.method: 1. 自然实验设计：将 /youtube/ 语料库设为处理组，同一域名下其他路径设为对照组，两者共享相同的平台顺风、域名权威与分析配置。2. 处理组合（2026 年 1 月起）：URL 规范化、利用 AI bot 404 日志挖掘需求、标题与导语改写、SEO 保护规则。3. 估计量：使用周度处理/对照比值 R(t) 的对数序列进行分段回归（ITS），含 HAC（Newey-West）标准误。4. 推断保障：移动块自助法置信区间 + 安慰剂-时间置换检验。5. 数据来源：GA4 Data API 一方服务器日志（而非第三方概率估计器）、Google Search Console。
AI.result: 1. 原始倍数夸大了效应：处理组月度增长 6.1×，对照组（无任何干预）也增长 3.5×，简单 DiD 约为 1.75×（会话）和 2.48×（参与会话）。2. ITS 模型在周度 log R 序列上估计出与干预对齐的离散水平跃升 exp(β₂)=1.82×（95% CI 1.31–2.54，HAC p=0.001），斜率变化不显著（p=0.53）。3. 稳健性：参与会话下 2.27×、剔除早 5 月尖峰 1.83×、更晚预窗口 2.07×，均落在 1.8–2.3× 区间。4. 安慰剂检验 p=0.16，效应为"暗示性"而非结论性。5. SEO 安全：处理页 Google 有机点击下降约 25%，与全站下降 20% 趋势一致；展示量未塌缩，无去索引化现象。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心方法论贡献是：使用同域对照从平台顺风中分离 AEO 干预效应。在 glasp.co 案例中，可信的、经平台调整后的水平效应约为 1.8–2.3×（安慰剂 p=0.16，暗示性），远低于媒体宣传的原始倍数（5–38×），且未对 SEO 造成可测损害。论文主张"域内对照+一方日志+ITS+安慰剂检验"应成为报告 AEO 效果的标准做法，并警示许多公开 AEO 倍数被平台尾部增长系统性高估。主要局限：单域、单引擎、非随机化、预期间较短且有显著预趋势。

title: Beyond Retrieval: Learning Compact User Representations for Scalable LLM Personalization
summary: Personalizing large language models requires adapting model behavior to individual users while preserving robustness and deployment-scale efficiency. Existing approaches typically personalize LLMs either at the input level, by retrieving user histories or constructing profile prompts, or at the parameter level, by maintaining user-specific parameter-efficient modules. The former makes personalization sensitive to retrieval quality and prompt design, whereas the latter incurs storage and maintenance costs that grow with the user population. To address these limitations, we propose TAP-PER (Temporal Attentive Prefix for PERsonalization), a prefix-based framework that encodes user preferences as learnable representations, eliminating explicit prompt construction and replacing heavy per-user adapters with lightweight user-state prefix embeddings. Inspired by personalized recommendation systems, TAP-PER decomposes user modeling into user-state and query-conditioned components, and incorporates temporal signals to capture the evolving nature of user interests. Experiments on six LaMP tasks show that TAP-PER consistently outperforms prompt-based and model-based baselines across classification, rating, and generation settings. Moreover, TAP-PER uses 130x fewer per-user parameters than OPPU and roughly half the total parameter footprint of PER-PCS at the 1,000-user scale, demonstrating that scalable LLM personalization can be achieved without explicit prompt construction or heavy per-user adapters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TAP-PER（Temporal Attentive Prefix for PERsonalization），一种基于前缀的 LLM 个性化框架，通过将用户偏好编码为可学习的紧凑前缀嵌入（用户状态前缀 + 查询感知的时序记录前缀），消除显式 prompt 构建并以轻量级前缀替代重型 per-user 适配器，实现可扩展的大模型个性化。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 个性化方法存在三大痛点：(1) 基于 prompt 的方法（RAG/PAG）对检索质量和 prompt 设计高度敏感，缺乏鲁棒性且存在暴露用户历史的隐私风险；(2) 基于 PEFT 的方法（OPPU、PER-PCS、P2P）为每个用户维护专用适配器或通过超网络生成参数，存储和训练成本随用户规模线性增长；(3) 现有方法大多将历史视为静态上下文，忽视用户兴趣的时序演化。作者由此提出核心问题：能否在不使用 prompt 构建和重型 per-user 参数的前提下实现可扩展的 LLM 个性化？
AI.method: 采用两阶段训练范式。第一阶段（Task Adaptation）：在聚合所有用户数据上用 LoRA 对骨干模型（如 Llama-3.1-8B）做任务级微调，训练完成后将 LoRA 合并入骨干参数。第二阶段（Personalized Prefix Learning）：冻结任务适应后的骨干，学习三部分参数：(1) 用户状态前缀 P_u——从可学习嵌入表 E 中取出每个用户的 e_u 并 reshape 为 L×d 的前缀矩阵，编码长期偏好；(2) 查询感知的记录前缀 P_q——借鉴推荐系统中的 DIN 注意力机制，对用户完整历史记录（无需外部检索器）做时序衰减注意力，注意力分数额外减去 λ_t·log(1+Δt) 和 λ_o·log(1+Δπ) 两项可学习的时序偏置（时间间隔与顺序间隔），用 MLP 投影到前缀空间；(3) 共享的 bridge LoRA——作用于每个 Transformer 块的 Q/K/V/O 投影，将前缀信号深度整合到骨干的中间表示中。三个组件联合优化，损失为交叉熵。默认前缀长度 L=8。注意 P_u 和 P_q 可视为 PAG 和 RAG 的参数化对应物。
AI.result: 在 LaMP 基准的 6 个任务（LaMP-1/2N/2M/3/4/5，覆盖分类、评分、生成）上，TAP-PER 在所有 12 个任务-指标对上均取得最优，显著优于 RAG、PAG、OPPU、PER-PCS 和 P2P 基线。亮点包括：LaMP-2M Acc 较最佳 OPPU 变体提升 7.2 个点，LaMP-5 R-1 提升 2.8 个点。消融实验证实 bridge LoRA、P_u、P_q 三者互补贡献。时序偏置消融和案例可视化表明时间间隔和顺序间隔对捕获演化兴趣均重要。参数量方面：每个用户仅需约 32K 参数的前缀（相比 OPPU 的 ~4.2M LoRA 减少 130×），1000 用户规模下总参数量仅为 OPPU 的 5.7%、PER-PCS 的约 53%。敏感性分析表明全历史注意力优于 BM25 预过滤，前缀长度 L=8 为最佳。在线适应实验中，仅更新 P_u 的 Online-Emb 和更新全部 Stage 2 参数的 Online-Full 均可从流式反馈中持续提升，且 Online-Full 接近全量重训练的性能。使用 Qwen3-4B 骨干的额外实验进一步验证了方法的泛化性（10/12 任务-指标对最优）。
AI.conclusion: TAP-PER 将 LLM 个性化重新定义为可学习的用户表示建模问题，通过用户状态前缀（持久偏好）、查询感知的时序记录前缀（历史证据）和共享 bridge LoRA 三个轻量组件的组合，在不使用 prompt 工程和重型 per-user 适配器的前提下，实现了优于现有 prompt-based 和 model-based 方法的个性化效果，同时将 per-user 存储减少 130×、总参数量减少近半，并支持对流式反馈的持续在线适应，无需重训骨干。论文呼吁未来工作关注表示中心的个性化范式，并探索多样性感知的目标以避免过度个性化。局限性方面包括：对极长/嘈杂历史的注意力质量可能下降，未在大规模骨干上验证，以及时序衰减设计可能加剧过滤气泡效应。

title: BEATS: Bootstrapping E-commerce Attribute Taxonomies for Search through Iterative Human-AI Collaboration
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Accepted to SIGIR 2026 Industry Track. Official version: this https URL
summary: E-commerce platforms in emerging markets often operate with underdeveloped product catalogs that contain only category taxonomies but lack structured attribute schemas. This absence of fine-grained product attributes limits search capabilities -- preventing faceted filtering, degrading query understanding, and weakening semantic representations used by search systems. We present BEATS, a human-in-the-loop LLM framework for bootstrapping product attribute taxonomies entirely from scratch. Our approach extends a multi-stage LLM generation pipeline with two critical production stages: (1) proactive quality checking by model developers to filter erroneous outputs, and (2) human annotation by domain-expert local staff to validate generated attributes. The framework operates iteratively -- prompts at each generation stage are refined based on quality check observations and annotator feedback across successive rounds, progressively improving attribute quality. Once the attribute taxonomy is established, we employ LLMs to perform structured attribute tagging on individual product items, enriching their contextual representations. The enriched catalog directly benefits multiple components of the search system: enabling granular attribute-based filtering, providing structured features for ranking models, and improving semantic representations for dense retrieval. We validate the generated taxonomy by training dense retrieval models on attribute-enriched product data, demonstrating consistent improvements over baselines using original catalog information. Our system has been deployed at Rakuten Taiwan, enriching 9 major categories spanning 2,694 sub-categories with 67,277 generated attributes, and over 5.4 million products have been tagged with the generated attributes, with plans to enrich the entire product catalog.

AI.tldr: BEATS是一个用于电子商务平台的"人在回路"(human-in-the-loop)大语言模型框架，旨在从零开始为缺乏结构化属性模式的商品目录(尤其是新兴市场的电商平台)自动构建属性分类体系。该框架通过多源LLM生成、合成、主动质量检查和领域专家标注的多阶段流水线，并基于人类反馈迭代优化提示词，最终在Rakuten台湾成功部署，为9个主要类别(2,694个子类)生成了67,277个属性，并标注了超过540万件商品。
AI.motivation: 新兴市场的电商平台(如Rakuten台湾)通常只有基础的商品类别分类体系，但缺乏细粒度的结构化属性模式(如品牌、材质、尺寸、颜色等)。这种缺失严重限制了搜索能力：无法进行多面过滤(分面搜索)、削弱了查询理解能力和搜索系统所使用的语义表示质量。而人工为成千上万的类别构建属性分类体系成本极高。现有基于LLM的自动分类构建方法虽然有前景，但存在单次生成不一致、幻觉属性等质量问题，且通常假设已有属性模式存在——无法解决"冷启动"问题。
AI.method: BEATS采用五阶段迭代流水线：(1)多源生成——多个异构LLM(GPT-OSS-120B、Qwen3-30B、Qwen3-VL-235B)独立生成候选属性，最大化覆盖度；(2)生成式合成——一个LLM汇总多个候选集，解决命名冲突、合并互补信息；(3)定向精炼——交叉参照类别层级关系去噪，去除与平台原生结构(如价格)重复的属性；(4)主动质量检查——模型开发人员审查系统性问题；(5)人类标注——领域专家(11名本地员工)对每个属性进行"接受/不确定/拒绝"的多人多数投票标注。关键创新在于**迭代提示词精炼**：第4-5阶段的反馈用于精炼第1-3阶段的提示词，每轮应用于不同的类别集，渐进式改善输出质量。属性值集合不在生成阶段预定义，而是通过下游的属性标注(LLM根据商品标题和描述预测属性值)自然形成。
AI.result: **属性分类质量**：经过两轮迭代，接受率从89.00%(Round 1)跃升至99.88%(Round 2)，拒绝率从3.43%降至0.015%。100%标注人员认为Round 2质量优于Round 1。完全一致性(3/3投票)从73.27%升至96.34%，完全分歧(1-1-1)从3.60%降至0.09%。**密集检索效果**：在Rakuten台湾商品搜索的bi-encoder密集检索模型中，属性增强表示在所有指标上一致优于基线——Recall@10从66.6提升至70.4(+5.7%)，NDCG@10从49.2提升至52.0(+5.7%)，MRR@10从44.5提升至46.9(+5.4%)。**属性标注质量**：LLM-as-a-judge评估的标注质量总分达0.933(9个主要类别、30,617个样本)，Round 2类别(0.936)优于Round 1(0.926)。**部署规模**：已部署于Rakuten台湾，9个主要类别、2,694个子类、67,277个生成属性、540万+件标注商品。
AI.conclusion: BEATS是首个生产部署的从零开始引导属性分类体系的人机协作LLM框架，证明了结合多阶段LLM生成与主动质量检查和领域专家标注、并基于人类反馈迭代精炼提示词的方法，能够为电商平台大规模生产高质量的结构化属性分类体系。该工作贡献了：(1)BEATS框架本身；(2)由人类反馈驱动的迭代提示词精炼方法论；(3)生成属性可提升搜索系统性能的实证验证。关键经验包括：主动质量检查至关重要(避免标注人员被系统性问题淹没)、跨市场知识迁移有局限(日本平台的属性仅可作为软参考)、类别层级上下文能显著减少越界属性、更强的精炼模型能更好降低残留噪声、分类体系质量是标注质量的上限。未来工作方向包括：主动学习以提高标注效率、自动属性值层级生成、扩展到查询理解和学习排序。

title: Plateau That Never Comes: When Efficiency Claims in Datacenters and AI Become Greenwashing
summary: Datacenter expansion under generative AI is increasingly framed as compatible with sustainability because of efficiency gains, cleaner electricity procurement, and improved facility design. Yet these claims often do not show that absolute electricity, water, material, waste, and community-facing burdens are falling. This Perspective addresses that evidentiary gap. Rather than asking whether efficiency gains are real, we ask when such gains are being enlarged into claims of system-wide sustainability to justify continued expansion. We develop a rebound-informed diagnostic framework for evaluating AI and datacenter sustainability narratives across five tests: metric, boundary, reinvestment, burden shifting, and governance. Applied to major AI industry sustainability reporting, the framework shows that firms largely justify continued expansion through efficiency improvements and clean-energy procurement, rather than by demonstrating reductions in absolute resource use. Applied to plateau claims in the literature, we show that many claims establish local or relative improvements while leaving energy rebound, lifecycle burdens, and enforceable limits unresolved. We argue that these sustainable-growth narratives begin to function as greenwashing when they use efficiency improvements to claim sustainability even as absolute energy, water, material, and public health burdens continue to increase. We conclude by positioning digital sufficiency as a burden-of-proof framework for governance: those advocating further datacenter expansion must show that it reduces, rather than merely redistributes or defers, absolute burdens across the full system.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇发表在arXiv上的Perspective（观点性）论文，针对当前生成式AI驱动的数据中心扩张中普遍存在的"可持续性"叙事提出批判。文章指出，企业与学术界常以"效率提升""清洁电力采购""设施优化"等论据，将相对减排（per-unit efficiency gains）包装成"绝对减排"（absolute reduction），从而为持续扩张提供正当性。作者基于"反弹效应"（rebound effect）理论提出了五项诊断性测试——指标测试、边界测试、再投资测试、负担转移测试、治理测试，并将该框架同时应用于五家主要AI/云厂商（Google、AWS、Microsoft、Meta、Equinix）的可持续报告和学术文献中的"平台期"（plateau）叙事，最终论证这些叙事已开始发挥"洗绿"（greenwashing）的社会功能，并提出以"数字充足性"（digital sufficiency）作为治理上的举证责任框架。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI浪潮正推动数据中心电力、用水、物质和社区层面负担持续上升，但业界与部分学术研究却越来越频繁地以"效率提升"和"清洁能源采购"为由，将扩张叙事包装为可持续。文章的动机不在于质疑效率提升本身的真实性，而在于揭示：当效率改进被"放大"为系统级可持续性主张、并被用来为无止境的扩张提供合法性时，这些叙事已构成"洗绿"。作者希望通过建立一个可操作的诊断框架，让"相对减排≠绝对减排"这一关键区分在治理、政策与公共讨论中变得可被识别和问责。
AI.method: 方法论上，这是一篇规范性/诊断性的Perspective，核心方法是构建并应用一个"反弹效应知情"的五项诊断测试框架：(1) 指标测试——检验所用指标是反映强度改进还是绝对总量；(2) 边界测试——检验上游、下游、社区侧负担是否被排除在核算之外；(3) 再投资测试——检验效率收益是否被重新投入到更大规模工作负载中（即Jevons-style反弹）；(4) 负担转移测试——检验负担是否在生命周期阶段、地理、时间或核算类别之间被转移而非减少；(5) 治理测试——检验是否有约束总量的制度机制，而不仅仅是自愿承诺。研究材料包括五家头部AI/云厂商（Google、AWS、Microsoft、Meta、Equinix）的公开可持续披露，以及历史与当前关于"数据中心电力平台期"和"生成式AI轨迹放缓"的代表性学术与情景报告。方法上辅以"数字充足性"理论（Santarius等人），将其重构为扩展方的举证责任框架。
AI.result: 框架应用于企业报告（Table A.1）显示：五家企业一致呈现"持续扩张+效率/采购+无上限承诺"的结构，均在指标、边界、（负荷转移）和治理测试上出现反复失败，且其报告自身亦未承诺任何需求或吞吐量的绝对上限。应用于学术与情景报告中的"平台期"叙事（Table A.2）显示，文章将现有论点归为六类家族——历史数据中心平台期、训练平台期、推理效率乐观主义、合成数据与长寿模型、时空负担转移、"逆风"与远景技术——并指出这些叙事普遍以"局部相对改进"跳跃到"系统级绝对下降"主张，缺乏对反弹效应、全生命周期负担、时空负担转移和治理机制的实证支撑。综合来看，作者论证：当一项主张在五项测试中均失败，却仍以"可持续""净零"或"平台期"自我标榜时，其社会功能已等同于洗绿。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出三点结论：(1) 可持续性主张必须证明的不仅是局部效率提升，而是该提升能够转化为绝对减排、避免再投资回规模扩张、不将负担转移至其他环节/地区/时间，并由具有约束力的治理机制托底；(2) 主张进一步扩张的一方应承担举证责任，需证明扩张会减少（而非仅仅再分配或推迟）系统全边界的绝对负担；(3) "数字充足性"应被作为治理层面的条件性框架，在三个维度落地——基础设施与硬件采购侧（运营配置上限、算力按需分配、物质与采购上限）、软件与模型设计侧（披露训练与推理需求、挑战"持续自动调用"的默认设置）、经济治理侧（公共用途导向的资本配置、反垄断与结构性分离、用户界面层嵌入充足性选项）。最终的政策与研究问题不是"算力能否更高效"，而是"社会是否愿意定义多少算力是足够的"。

authors: et al. (88 additional authors not shown)
title: Prioritization of Risks from Artificial Intelligence: A Delphi Study of 272 International Experts
comment: Access data at this https URL
summary: Artificial intelligence poses many risks, ranging from familiar present-day harms to unprecedented and potentially catastrophic ones. Effective risk management requires prioritization: we must understand which risks are most severe, who is most vulnerable, and who is most responsible for addressing them. We report results from a three-round Delphi study conducted late 2025 with 272 international AI experts. Experts rated 24 AI risks on harm probability and severity, sector and actor vulnerability, actor responsibility, and overall concern. Experts estimated the five most severe harms in the next 5 years were likely to come from dangerous capabilities, competitive dynamics, weapons & cyberattacks (including CBRNE), power centralization, and false information. In a business-as-usual scenario, experts judged 18 of 24 risks as having a more than 10% probability of catastrophic outcomes (e.g., more than 1 million deaths or more than USD 100B in financial loss) in the next 5 years (2025-2030). In a scenario where pragmatic mitigations are implemented, experts still judged five risks as having a more than 10% probability of catastrophic outcomes: dangerous capabilities, weapons & cyberattacks, environmental harm, inequality & unemployment, and power centralization. All 24 risks were judged as being more than 5% likely to cause catastrophic outcomes. AI users and the general public were judged the most vulnerable to these risks, but experts assigned the highest responsibility for addressing them to general-purpose AI developers and governance actors (including governments, regulators, and standards bodies). Across most risks, experts identified information, finance, and national security as the most vulnerable sectors. These findings can guide AI risk prioritization and clarify expert expectations about who should bear responsibility for mitigation.

AI.tldr: 该论文报告了一项2025年末进行的Delphi研究，272位国际AI专家对24类AI风险在伤害概率与严重性、行业与行为者脆弱性、行为者责任及总体关注度上进行了评估，旨在为AI风险优先级排序提供实证依据。
AI.motivation: AI带来从当下危害到潜在灾难性风险的多重威胁，有效的风险管理需要明确风险的严重性、脆弱性群体及责任主体，但目前缺乏系统性的专家共识来指导风险优先级排序与责任分配。
AI.method: 采用三轮Delphi调查法，于2025年末邀请272位国际AI专家，对24类AI风险在五个维度（伤害概率与严重性、行业脆弱性、行为者脆弱性、行为者责任、总体关注度）上进行评分，并区分"业务照常"与"实施务实缓解措施"两种情景进行估计。
AI.result: 专家估计未来5年最严重的五大伤害来源为：危险能力、竞争动态、武器与网络攻击（含CBRNE）、权力集中及虚假信息。在业务照常情景下，24项风险中有18项被判断为在未来5年内发生灾难性后果（如超过100万人死亡或超过1000亿美元经济损失）的概率超过10%；在实施务实缓解措施情景下，仍有5项风险（危险能力、武器与网络攻击、环境危害、不平等与失业、权力集中）的灾难性概率超过10%。所有24项风险的灾难性概率均被判断超过5%。AI用户与普通公众被认为最脆弱，而通用AI开发者与治理主体（含政府、监管机构、标准机构）被赋予最高的应对责任。信息、金融与国家安全被识别为最脆弱的行业领域。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过大规模专家共识明确了AI风险的优先级排序、脆弱性分布与责任分配，为AI风险治理框架的制定提供了实证依据，并明确了各方行为者在风险缓解中应承担的责任。

title: Agentic AI and Pedagogical Best Practice: The Tension Between Automation and Learning
comment: Accepted for publication at AIED 2026 - Festival of Learning HAI-Agency Workshop on Orchestrating Human and AI Agency for Proactive and Reflective Learning
summary: Artificial intelligence in education is evolving from passive chatbots to proactive AI agents capable of initiation and goal-directed interactions. While offering opportunities for personalised learning, this shift risks undermining learner agency and cognitive effort. This paper reviews six pedagogical principles-prior knowledge activation, collaborative learning, problem-based learning, formative assessment, scaffolding, and metacognition-through the lens of agentic AI. We discuss the tension between automation and learning, proposing design recommendations that prioritise intentional friction, dynamic scaffolding, human-in-the-loop oversight, and considered AI utilisation to ensure AI supports rather than supplants human learning.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了主动型AI代理（agentic AI）在教育中的应用，通过审视六项教学法原则（先前知识激活、协作学习、问题导向学习、形成性评估、支架式教学与元认知），揭示了自动化与学习之间的张力，并提出以"有意摩擦"、动态支架消退和"教师在环"为核心的设计建议，确保AI支持而非取代人类学习。
AI.motivation: 随着教育AI从被动聊天机器人演进为主动型目标驱动代理，虽然为个性化学习带来机遇，但存在削弱学习者主体性与认知努力的风险。文章指出，过度依赖AI会导致"认知投降"（cognitive surrender），即学习者将本应自行完成的批判性综合与分析外包给AI，从而损害深度处理、批判性思维、专注力与创造力等核心人类学习要素。因此，有必要从既有教学法理论出发，审视主动型AI的设计原则。
AI.method: 本文采用理论综述与设计框架构建方法，以教育文献中六项经过验证的"最佳实践"教学原则（先前知识与经验、协作与团队学习、问题导向学习、形成性评估与实时反馈、支架式教学、元认知与反思）为分析框架，分别从"机遇"与"挑战"两个维度逐一探讨主动型AI的介入影响。在此基础上，构建"主动型AI实施矩阵"，将各教学原则映射为具体的智能体行动、摩擦/消退策略与教学情境示例，并在讨论部分提出四项设计建议。
AI.result: 1) 六项教学原则在主动型AI介入下均呈现"机遇-挑战"二元结构：先验知识激活面临算法假设与文化错位风险；协作学习面临真实人际连接丧失；问题导向学习面临生产性挣扎被削弱；形成性评估面临评估完整性与隐私问题；支架式教学面临"消退困境"与习得性无助；元认知面临表面合规而非内化调节。2) 提出"主动型AI实施矩阵"，将每项原则转化为可操作的系统行为与摩擦/消退机制。3) 提出四项设计建议：设计摩擦（Design for Friction）、实施动态消退（Implement Dynamic Fading）、架构层面的"教师在环"（Teacher-in-the-Loop，包含升级协议、目标与护栏可调性、状态可中断性）以及AI使用克制（AI Usage Restraint，借鉴SAMR模型避免简单替代或增强）。
AI.conclusion: 主动型AI的根本风险在于：优化任务完成效率的同时，可能绕过深度学习所需的认知努力。文章主张教学完整性优先于效率，AI应被设计为支持学习者主体性的工具而非认知替代品。通过有意工程化的"教学摩擦"、动态支架消退、教师在环的架构干预以及对AI使用的审慎判断，可以在自动化与人类学习之间取得平衡，最终目标是强化而非削弱学生思考、感受与创造的能力。

title: When Firms Learn to Game the Rules
comment: Includes synthetic simulation data, source code, figures, and reproducibility materials
summary: Rules-as-Code promises more testable legal obligations, but it also changes what regulated firms can learn. Existing work mostly emphasizes implementation gains; the strategic gap is whether machine-readable rules make boundary search cheaper. I study that gap with a synthetic agent-based reinforcement-learning simulation that separates actual conduct near a legal threshold from proximity in the computable enforcement signal. Across 150 seed-level scenario runs, 378 common-random-number computability-sweep runs, 288 Latin-hypercube global-design runs, and a 2,880,000-row firm-period panel, computable static rules raise conduct boundary mass relative to ambiguous static rules (0.411 versus 0.367) and raise signal boundary mass more sharply (0.403 versus 0.281). Ordinary adaptive updates lower consumer harm (0.202 to 0.194) but do not reliably reduce boundary search. A budget-neutral anti-gaming design reduces conduct boundary mass by 0.032 and consumer harm by 0.025 relative to computable static rules. These are mechanism-oriented synthetic results, not estimates of real firm behavior in a jurisdiction or industry. The contribution is an estimand distinction, an inspectable ABM/RL mechanism, and a reproducible artifact showing that transparent behavioral assumptions are sufficient to generate gaming-like boundary dynamics without implying that computable regulation is inherently undesirable.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于智能体（ABM）与强化学习（RL）的合成仿真，研究当法律规则变得"可计算化"（Rules-as-Code）时，受监管企业是否会向法律边界聚集，以及自适应反博弈设计能否在不增加审计总量的前提下降低消费者损害。核心贡献是提出了"行为边界质量"（conduct boundary mass）与"信号边界质量"（signal boundary mass）的可估计量区分，并通过大规模仿真表明：可计算化确实会同时提升信号聚集与真实行为聚集，单纯的适应性更新不足以抑制边界搜索，而预算中性的反博弈设计（随机审计+结果护栏）可同时降低边界质量与消费者损害。
AI.motivation: Rules-as-Code与敏捷监管治理（OECD）强调机器可读规则带来的执行效率提升，但既有研究忽视了一个战略问题：可计算化是否同时降低了企业"边界搜索"的成本？当规则的执行信号更清晰时，企业可能更精确定位合法与非法之间的灰色地带（Schauer意义上的"沿线行走"），这与Goodhart定律在法律场景中的特殊表现相关。本文旨在填补这一战略缺口，并区分"信号更清晰"与"行为更接近边界"两种机制。
AI.method: 采用合成ABM/RL仿真，包含四类智能体：企业（7种策略、表格Q-learning）、监管者（5种制度体制：模糊静态/可计算静态/可计算自适应/RL监管者/反博弈自适应）、消费者、竞争者模仿网络。可计算性作为复合参数束（阈值清晰度+信号精度+调整速度+执行可见性+模仿+漏洞危害）。实验设计包括：30种子×240期×80企业的核心场景、378次公共随机数可计算性扫描、288次拉丁超立方全局设计、288万行企业-期面板数据。推断方法包括配对符号翻转检验、Holm校正p值、去重叠事件研究、企业-期转移矩阵分析，并通过通道消融、边界ε检验、惩罚变体进行鲁棒性测试。
AI.result: (1) 静态可计算化使行为边界质量从0.367升至0.411，信号边界质量从0.281升至0.403，消费者损害从0.175升至0.202；(2) 单纯自适应更新可降低损害（0.202→0.194），但对行为边界质量的配对效应仅-0.002且统计上不稳定；(3) 预算中性反博弈设计在同等审计预算下将行为边界质量降低0.032、消费者损害降低0.025、边缘策略占比从0.868降至0.802，但干预触发率从0.041升至0.098；(4) RL监管者虽能降低损害，但产生最高规则变更（churn=3.111），说明学习能力本身不等于制度设计；(5) 拉丁超立方敏感性显示可计算性对信号边界质量标准化系数为0.972（R²=0.978），对行为边界质量为0.780（R²=0.749），结果护栏对消费者损害的系数为-0.144；(6) 信号精度单独无法复现行为结果（仅得0.376 vs 全束0.413），验证了行为变化非纯测量伪影。
AI.conclusion: 本文的机制主张审慎：可计算化监管不应被简单视为优或劣，其制度设计决定了它究竟是稳定的执行工具还是战略搜索的目标。政策含义包括：(1) 需将行为导向与信号导向的诊断指标分开报告；(2) 确定性阈值应辅以随机化审计注意力（但仅用于选择审查对象，不可创设隐性实体法）；(3) 结果护栏应触发审查、安全港撤回或举证转移，而非自动责任；(4) 适应性更新逻辑本身可被企业学习，更新频率高不等于好设计。研究局限在于：模型抽象于具体法域，动作空间离散，Q-learning简单，且未纳入法院、政治延迟、法律挑战等制度因素；下一步可对具体监管域进行校准并引入司法审查对自适应规则的约束。

title: Dark Path: An Analysis of the Belt & Road Initiative in El Salvador
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, Cleared for Release on 19 MAY 2026 (DOPSR 26-P-0621)
summary: The Belt & Road Initiative (BRI) is a concerted effort from Ministries under the People's Republic of China (PRC) to diplomatically and economically impose its will upon other nations. El Salvador is a US partner and a beneficiary of foreign investment under the BRI. Recent changes to Salvadoran law do not address the implied risks to the nation's supply-chain and cyber infrastructure. This work addresses the gap by exploring previously limited analysis on BRI activities, its intersection with Salvadoran law, and the national security risks introduced by supply-chain reliance from the BRI. This exploratory study examined a portion of the William & Mary AidData dataset filtered on El Salvador, social media posts, news articles, white papers, and law published by the Legislative Assembly of El Salvador. The analysis suggests that the BRI poses a national security and supply-chain risk to El Salvador through influential-subterfuge, loss of digital sovereignty, which contradicts the State Cybersecurity Agency (ACE) and existing Salvadoran laws. This study provides a foundational understanding and regional context for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项关于"一带一路"倡议(BRI)在萨尔瓦多影响的探索性定性研究。作者通过分析William & Mary AidData数据集、社交媒体、新闻、白皮书及萨尔瓦多法律,发现BRI通过"影响力-隐蔽手段"(influential-subterfuge)和中国硬件饱和策略,对萨尔瓦多构成国家安全与供应链风险,并导致"数字主权"丧失。同时,萨尔瓦多现行网络安全法(第143号法令)和隐私法(第144号法令)存在法律盲区(技术中立条款、私营部门管辖空白),无法有效应对上述威胁,与国家网络安全局(ACE)的职责存在矛盾。
AI.motivation: 现有BRI研究多聚焦于全球宏观视角或将其视为经济机遇,缺乏对拉美等"被遗忘的全球南方"国家的个案研究,尤其在网络安全与地缘政治交叉领域存在显著空白。萨尔瓦多2018年与台湾断交后转向中国大陆,接受大量BRI项目投资和硬件捐赠,使其在美国与中国之间陷入两难,面临被中国通过经济影响力施加隐蔽战略优势的风险。然而,萨尔瓦多2024年新设立的网络安全机构(ACE)及配套法律未能充分评估BRI带来的供应链和网络安全风险,亟需系统性研究以填补政策空白。
AI.method: 采用生态学探索性定性研究方法,通过多源数据三角验证:① 学术数据——William & Mary AidData数据集筛选萨尔瓦多相关BRI事件(2018-2023年约68起);② 事件数据——2024年至今,通过X(原Twitter)采集中国驻萨尔瓦多大使馆、当地新闻媒体及公民账号内容;③ 威胁情报数据——Google/Mandiant、Team Cymru等业界报告;④ 政策数据——萨尔瓦多立法议会发布的法律,经Claude AI及第三方智库交叉翻译验证。资金按"承诺年份"而非完成年份分析,采用非概率抽样,侧重政府渠道的便利性采样。
AI.result: 研究识别出BRI在萨尔瓦多的三条主要风险路径:① **影响力-隐蔽手段**:通过捐赠、贷款、赠款等"软实力"投射实现经济杠杆,2020年(疫情期+断交后)为投资高峰;② **硬件饱和与数字主权丧失**:2018年向558所学校捐赠15,000台笔记本电脑;2020年捐赠322台华为平板;2021年提供技术培训中心资助;2023年出资50万美元建设海底电缆;2024年华为举办"种子未来峰会"培训5G/AI技术;2026年再向学生捐赠344,000台设备(规模较2018年增加约23倍);③ **法律矛盾**:ACE管辖范围仅限公共部门,Decree 143第3条§J"技术中立"条款允许任何被视为"安全高效"的技术(包括华为);Decree 144第3条§C对"公共安全""国防""国家安全"的宽泛豁免使政府数据保护存在盲区。这些漏洞使萨尔瓦多面临被纳入中国ORB网络、丧失数字主权的风险。
AI.conclusion: BRI通过经济依赖、硬件渗透和制度性法律漏洞,对萨尔瓦多构成系统性国家安全与供应链风险。中国军民融合战略、华为等企业受中国《网络安全法》《情报法》约束,使其设备存在潜在后门风险;萨尔瓦多的"技术中立"原则与私营部门监管盲区加剧了风险。建议:未来研究可通过实地调查、官员访谈、技术行动研究等方法深化;萨尔瓦多应考虑禁止高风险中国硬件(如美澳北约的做法),或扩展ACE权限至私营部门,弥合法律漏洞。本研究为拉美区域BRI网络安全风险研究提供了基础框架和区域语境。

title: Does Artificial Intelligence Advance Science?
summary: This paper examines whether and how artificial intelligence (AI) advances scientific creativity. Drawing on scientific publications, the primary output of researchers, we analyze over one million publications from OpenAlex to investigate the relationship between AI adoption and multiple dimensions of scientific creativity, including novelty (recombinant novelty and object novelty) and impact (3-year short-run citation impact and 10-year long-run citation impact). We find that AI publications are significantly more likely to achieve top-decile creativity relative to non-AI publications, with 5.5 to 10.2 percentage point higher likelihood to rank in the top creativity decile. Critically, we uncover substantial heterogeneity across AI research modes. Tool-oriented AI research, which applies existing AI models to domain tasks, is associated with the largest gains in recombinant-based creativity, while Adaptation-oriented AI research, modifying AI models for domain-specific problems, is associated with relatively higher object-based creativity. These findings reveal that AI does not advance science through a single mechanism but through structurally distinct creative pathways that depend on how AI is incorporated into the research process. Our results contribute to ongoing debates about AI's role in science and carry direct implications for research evaluation and science policy, highlighting the need for assessment frameworks that can distinguish between recombinant and conceptual forms of creativity and that recognize how different modes of AI adoption produce fundamentally different types of scientific contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文基于OpenAlex超过一百万篇学术出版物，探究AI应用对科学创造力（新颖性与影响力）的影响，发现AI出版物进入创造力前十分位的概率显著高于非AI出版物5.5至10.2个百分点，且不同AI研究模式通过结构性不同的路径促进科学创造力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对AI如何影响科学创造力的讨论存在分歧，且缺乏对不同AI应用模式如何差异化地影响科学创造力的系统理解。本研究旨在揭示AI是否以及如何通过不同机制提升科学创造力，为科研评估与科学政策提供实证依据。
AI.method: 采用文献计量学方法，从OpenAlex数据库提取超过一百万篇学术出版物，识别AI相关出版物并将其分类为"工具导向型"（应用现有AI模型）和"适应导向型"（修改AI模型解决领域问题）两种研究模式。创造力从两个维度测量：新颖性（重组型新颖性与对象型新颖性）和影响力（3年短期与10年长期引用影响力），通过分位数回归等方法比较AI与非AI出版物进入创造力前十分位的概率差异。
AI.result: AI出版物在创造力前十分位的概率显著高于非AI出版物5.5至10.2个百分点。异质性分析显示：工具导向型AI研究对重组型新颖性的提升最显著；适应导向型AI研究则对对象型新颖性的贡献相对更大。AI通过多重结构性路径而非单一机制推进科学进步。
AI.conclusion: AI通过结构上不同的创造性路径促进科学发展，其效果取决于AI被纳入研究过程的方式。研究呼吁建立能区分重组型与概念型创造力的科研评估框架，并重视不同AI采纳模式所产生的本质差异化的科学贡献。

title: Argus-Retriever: Vision-LLM Late-Interaction Retrieval with Region-Aware Query-Conditioned MoE for Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Late-interaction vision-language retrievers represent each document page as many visual token embeddings and score queries with MaxSim. In systems such as ColPali, ColQwen, ColNomic, and Nemotron ColEmbed, the document embeddings are produced without seeing the query, so the same page is represented identically for a table lookup, a chart question, and a layout-sensitive evidence request. We introduce \textbf{Argus}, a family of query-conditioned late-interaction retrievers built on Qwen3.5-VL. Argus adds a region-aware Mixture-of-Experts module: the query encoder produces both retrieval embeddings and a compact context vector, the document page is pooled into spatial regions, and a query-aware router selects latent experts per region before MaxSim. The output remains a multi-vector index compatible with ColPali-style retrieval, but the document representation is now dependent on the query (i.e., $\mathbf{D}(q)$). All Argus models use a 1024-dimensional retrieval head, compared with the 2560-dimensional and 4096-dimensional heads of recent state-of-the-art systems, and are trained on roughly 9\% of the available public supervision rather than the full pool. The 9B model reaches \textbf{92.67} NDCG@5 on ViDoRe V1 and \textbf{86.0} NDCG@5 on the combined V1+V2 leaderboard, the highest reported value for an open late-interaction model on the combined leaderboard. Wrapped in a Qwen3.6-27B agentic retrieval pipeline on ViDoRe V3, Argus-9B further improves its NDCG@10 from 60.28 to \textbf{64.80} over public tasks, showing that the same retriever serves both as a strong standalone system and as a search primitive for iterative LLM agents.

AI.tldr: Argus 提出了一种基于 Qwen3.5-VL 的查询条件化（query-conditioned）晚期交互视觉文档检索模型，通过区域感知的 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模块使同一文档页面对不同查询产生不同的多向量表示 D(q)。Argus-9B 在 ViDoRe V1+V2 上以 86.0 NDCG@5 达到开放晚期交互模型 SOTA，并以 1024 维检索头实现 4.5× 存储压缩与 13.6× 离线编码加速。
AI.motivation: 现有晚期交互 VDR 系统（ColPali、ColQwen、ColNomic、Nemotron ColEmbed）在编码文档时无法看到查询，因此同一页面在表格查询、图表问题、布局敏感请求等不同任务下表示完全相同。这种"查询无关"的文档表示限制了模型在异构证据分布（表格单元格、图表轴、图注、公式）上的适应能力，亟需在保留 ColPali 式多向量索引高效性的同时引入跨编码器级别的查询自适应能力。
AI.method: Argus 包含三个规模（2B/4B/9B）的 Qwen3.5-VL 模型，核心设计包括：(1) **查询分支**：编码查询得到检索嵌入 Q 和池化后的上下文向量 z_q；(2) **文档分支**：在 backbone 第 L-5 层抽取中间网格 G_early 用于路由，在第 L 层抽取最终网格 G_final 用于检索；(3) **区域池化**：将网格按 r=4 分块池化得到 N 个区域 token，并附带 2D 坐标 c_r；(4) **查询感知路由器**：将区域内容、坐标和 z_q 投影后相加，输入两层 MLP 产生 K=4 个潜在专家的 top-2 路由权重，使用温度 1.0 与训练时高斯噪声；(5) **专家库与共享专家**：4 个位置前馈专家 + 1 个始终激活的共享专家，专家权重广播到 patch 级后加权求和；(6) **门控残差融合**：通过可学习标量 α、β 将 G_final、共享专家输出与路由专家输出融合后投影为 1024 维 D(q)；(7) **训练**：两阶段（路由预热 + 联合训练），使用 InfoNCE + 负载均衡损失 + 路由交叉熵损失，PEFT/LoRA rank=32，仅用 9.3%（593,677 对）公开监督数据。推理时图像编码器离线运行一次，仅缓存查询无关特征，查询端在候选页上执行路由、融合与 MaxSim。
AI.result: Argus-9B 在 ViDoRe V1 上达到 92.67 NDCG@5，V1+V2 联合榜单上以 86.0 取得开放晚期交互模型 SOTA（领先 Nemotron-8b-v2 +1.3），并在 V2 四个 OOD 任务上全部最佳（BiomedicalLectures、ESGReports、ESGReports-HL、EconomicsReports）。在 ViDoRe V3 八个公开任务上 Argus-9B 达到 62.50 NDCG@10，与最强 8B 基线（63.53）相当。嵌入 Qwen3.6-27B 智能体后，V3 平均从 60.28 提升至 64.80 NDCG@10。MIRACL-Vision 多语言基准上 Argus-9B 取得 0.7552 平均分（最高），10 种语言中 5 种最佳。存储方面 Argus-9B 仅 4.2 MB/page，约为 Nemotron-8b-v2（18.9 MB/page）的 1/4.5；离线编码 374 ms/page（13.6× 加速），在线查询 136 ms（2.0× 加速）。消融实验表明查询条件 z_q、区域坐标 c_r、共享专家三者均贡献约 3-4 个 NDCG 点，K=4 与 L-5 路由抽取点为最优配置。
AI.conclusion: Argus 通过在晚期交互 VLM 检索流程中引入查询条件化区域感知 MoE 模块，使同一文档页面对不同查询产生差异化表示，同时保持 ColPali 式多向量索引的检索侧优势。Argus 2B/4B/9B 家族以更窄的 1024 维检索头与更小的训练混合在 ViDoRe V1+V2 上实现开放模型 SOTA，OOD 增益最大，且在存储-精度权衡上显著优于现有系统；同一检索器既可独立部署，也可作为迭代式 LLM 智能体的搜索原语。主要局限包括：继承了晚期交互的存储与查询延迟开销；查询条件化阻碍了一次性索引 D 的 ColPali 优化，需两阶段 retrieve-then-rerank 部署；V3 评估仅覆盖八个公开领域；潜在专家的语义不可解释，未显式约束为表格、图表等可解释类别。

title: Bridging Short Videos and Live Streams: Reasoning-Guided Multimodal LLMs for Cross-Domain Representation Learning
summary: As live streaming services grow, many platforms offer short videos and live streams to meet diverse needs. Short videos carry substantial traffic and rich behavior signals, whereas live streaming is a core conversion scenario with sparse behavior data, making cold start severe. Transferring user interests from short videos to live streaming recommendation can alleviate these issues. Meanwhile, short videos and live streams are complex multimodal items, and integrating multimodal signals improves recommendation performance. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show strong multimodal understanding and reasoning, their application to cross-domain recommendation remains underexplored. To this end, we propose Reasoning-Guided Cross-Domain Representation Learning (RGCD-Rep), a reasoning-guided framework for cross-domain recommendation from short videos to live streams. RGCD-Rep introduces MLLM reasoning resource-efficiently and learns transferable item representations guided by behavioral collaboration via two-stage training. First, reasoning-aware distillation lets a frozen teacher MLLM generate structured cross-domain reasoning knowledge and distills it into a lightweight student MLLM. Second, transferability-guided cross-domain representation learning decomposes item representations into transferable and domain residual representations. The resulting representations are computed offline and integrated into downstream retrieval tasks, enabling low-cost industrial deployment. Extensive offline experiments demonstrate RGCD-Rep's superiority. After deployment in Kuaishou's live streaming recommendation system, A/B tests show significant gains across multiple core business metrics, confirming its effectiveness and practicality in real industrial scenarios. RGCD-Rep is fully deployed and serves over 400 million users daily.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RGCD-Rep,一个面向短视频到直播跨域推荐的推理引导框架,通过将冻结的 35B 教师 MLLM 的链式推理能力蒸馏到轻量级 2B 学生 MLLM,并将物品表示分解为可迁移与域残差两部分,在快手直播推荐系统中已全量部署,日服务超 4 亿用户。
AI.motivation: 短视频域用户行为丰富但直播域行为稀疏,冷启动严重;现有跨域推荐多依赖预提取的静态多模态特征,缺乏深层次语义推理,且直接部署大规模 MLLM 工业成本过高,因此需要一种既能利用 MLLM 推理能力、又能低成本部署的跨域表示学习方法。
AI.method: 两阶段框架:(1) 利用真实行为日志构建"行为协同对"(短-直播),用 35B 教师 MLLM 通过 CoT 生成结构化跨域推理知识(三个语义维度:垂直领域、关键主体、内容主题),再用 NTP 损失将成对推理蒸馏为单物品级监督,微调 2B 学生 MLLM(Qwen2-VL-2B),并引入 16 个可学习的 chorus token 作为表示接口。(2) 冻结的学生 MLLM 作为权重共享编码器,通过可迁移-残差查询感知聚合模块,将 chorus token 表示拆分为可迁移视图 z^T 和残差视图 z^R,再以跨域对比学习(InfoNCE 双向)对齐行为协同对,并以行为强度 b_i 与语义可迁移分 r_i 联合构造的 routing 标签 π_i 训练 sigmoid 路由,抑制负迁移。最终 z^T 离线生成后接入下游检索。
AI.result: 在快手离线数据(109,523 用户,约 224.95M 条短-直播交互)上,HR@10/NDCG@10 分别达 0.0254/0.0127,较最强基线 UniEmbedding 提升 17.59% 和 30.93%;消融实验证明两阶段训练与 MLLM 微调均不可或缺;在长尾物品与冷启动用户群体上提升更显著。线上 A/B 测试一周,Kuaishou 与 Kuaishou Lite 的核心指标(曝光 +0.37%/+0.38%、点击 +0.34%/+0.13%、有效进入 +0.28%/+0.22%、关注 +0.83%/+0.93%)均显著正向。
AI.conclusion: RGCD-Rep 首次将 MLLM 推理引入跨域推荐,通过对齐师生 MLLM 蒸馏 + 可迁移-残差分解 + 行为协同对比与路由,既获得了 MLLM 强语义推理的收益,又通过离线嵌入生成实现了工业级低开销部署,有效缓解了直播推荐的数据稀疏和冷启动问题。

title: SAILRec: Steering LLM Attention to Dual-Side Semantically Aligned Collaborative Embeddings for Recommendation
summary: Recent LLM-based recommenders enhance language models with collaborative embeddings from user-item interactions, but making such embeddings available does not ensure their proper use during inference. Through a diagnostic attention analysis, we find that the utilization of collaborative embeddings is depth-dependent and alignment-sensitive, suggesting that LLMs need to balance their internal semantic knowledge with external collaborative knowledge. To address this issue, we propose SAILRec, an LLM-based recommender that improves this balance through dual-side semantic alignment and hierarchical attention steering. The former aligns item-side embeddings with item-text semantics and user-side embeddings with codebook-based semantic profiles, while the latter suppresses premature shallow-layer collaborative interference and strengthens collaborative evidence in deeper decision layers. Experiments on MovieLens-1M and Amazon-Book show that SAILRec consistently outperforms representative baselines, with ablation and masking analyses validating its key designs.

AI.tldr: SAILRec提出了一种基于LLM的推荐方法，通过双侧语义对齐（用户侧使用基于码本的风格/情感/意识形态语义画像，项目侧对齐物品文本语义）和分层注意力引导（浅层抑制、中层保持、深层增强对协作嵌入的注意力），改善LLM对外部协作知识的语义可访问性和层级利用方式，在MovieLens-1M和Amazon-Book上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推荐方法（如CoLLM、SeLLa-Rec）将协作嵌入注入LLM作为软令牌，但仅关注嵌入的构建与注入，忽视了LLM在推理过程中如何跨Transformer深度平衡内部语义知识与外部协作知识。诊断实验表明，协作嵌入的利用具有深度依赖性（浅层低注意力、深层活跃）和对齐敏感性（对齐方式显著影响利用模式），这促使作者解决两个核心问题：协作嵌入对LLM语义空间的可理解性，以及其在Transformer推理中的介入时机。
AI.method: SAILRec包含两大核心组件：(1) 双侧语义对齐——采用矩阵分解(MF)作为协作模型冻结提供用户/物品嵌入；用户侧构建基于码本（风格𝒞ᴬ、情感𝒞ᴮ、意识形态𝒞ᶜ）的语义画像，利用LLM编码器和加权投票选出每个用户最匹配的标签作为对齐目标，通过Collaborative Q-Former (C-QFormer)映射到三个Collab. token，并使用slot-wise InfoNCE损失对齐；物品侧使用单一可学习查询的C-QFormer将MF嵌入映射后与LLM物品标题语义表示做InfoNCE对齐。(2) 分层注意力引导——将L层Transformer划分为浅层、中层、深层三组，通过对Collab. token的key位置添加注意力logit偏置Δ：浅层设负偏置bₛ抑制过早协作干扰，中层设0保持自然交互，深层设递增正偏置b_d(ℓ)增强决策阶段的协作证据。三阶段训练：训练MF→对齐C-QFormer→LoRA微调+分层注意力引导联合优化。
AI.result: 在MovieLens-1M和Amazon-Book两个公开数据集上，SAILRec一致优于代表性基线方法（TALLRec、RecRanker、CoLLM、SeLLa-Rec等）。消融实验验证了双侧语义对齐（特别是用户侧码本画像和物品侧文本对齐）以及分层注意力引导（浅层抑制与深层增强）的关键设计均对性能有贡献。掩码分析进一步验证了Collab. token的实际效用及其层级利用模式。
AI.conclusion: SAILRec通过"双侧语义对齐 + 分层注意力引导"两大互补机制，有效解决了LLM推荐系统中协作嵌入的语义可访问性和层级利用问题。诊断分析揭示的"深度依赖性和对齐敏感性"现象为后续LLM+协作知识的研究提供了新的视角——不仅要关注嵌入的构造与注入，更应关注其与LLM语义空间的兼容性和在Transformer内部的层级使用模式。

title: Trading Engagement for Sustainability: Carbon-Aware Re-ranking for E-commerce Recommendations
comment: 23 pages, 30 figures. Code available at this https URL
summary: E-commerce recommender systems strongly influence which products users consider and purchase, yet sustainability signals such as Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) are almost never available at catalog scale. We study carbon-aware product recommendation in the realistic setting where PCF labels are missing for most items and must be inferred. We first estimate product-level carbon footprints via a retrieval-augmented PCF estimation pipeline that transfers supervision from the Carbon Catalogue, a small set of life-cycle-assessed products, to a large unlabeled e-commerce catalog using semantic similarity search, few-shot LLM prompting, and a nearest-neighbour fallback. We then apply a carbon-aware post-hoc re-ranking strategy on top of relevance scores produced by three established recommendation models: BPR, NeuMF, and LightGCN. The method trades off predicted user-item engagement against estimated carbon footprint through a single tunable parameter, lambda. In this offline study, engagement is operationalized through Amazon review interactions, which serve as implicit feedback and as a proxy for user interest or purchase behavior. We evaluate the framework on the Amazon Reviews dataset across three product categories: Home and Kitchen, Sports and Outdoors, and Electronics. By sweeping lambda, we construct Pareto frontiers that characterize the achievable engagement and carbon trade-off for each model and category. Substantial carbon reductions are achievable at minimal engagement cost across all models and categories. However, the available carbon headroom varies by model and category, underscoring the importance of model choice and domain context.

AI.tldr: 本文针对电商推荐系统中产品碳足迹（PCF）标签缺失的现实问题，提出了一种检索增强的PCF估计管道结合碳感知后置重排序的框架。通过单一可调参数λ在用户参与度与碳排放之间进行权衡，在三个推荐模型（BPR、NeuMF、LightGCN）和三个亚马逊商品类别上构建Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 电商推荐系统深刻影响用户的购买决策与消费模式，但大规模商品目录中几乎不存在产品碳足迹（PCF）标签，使得可持续性感知的推荐研究受到严重制约。现有研究要么假设PCF标签已存在，要么仅在小型领域数据集上操作，无法反映电商真实的大规模场景。同时，欧盟《赋能消费者绿色转型指令》及联合国SDG 12等政策法规对推荐系统的透明度和可持续性提出了明确要求，将排名算法视为消费选择架构的重要设计决策而非中立技术实现。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) **PCF估计管道**：将Carbon Catalogue中866个基于生命周期评估（LCA）的产品作为监督源，通过all-MiniLM-L6-v2句嵌入模型进行语义检索，提取5个最近邻作为少样本示例，使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct进行思维链推理估计PCF值，无效输出回退到近邻平均。同时对比了零样本LLM和纯近邻基线。(2) **推荐管道**：在RecBole框架下使用BPR（成对协同过滤）、NeuMF（神经矩阵分解）、LightGCN（图卷积协同过滤）三种模型生成候选，相关性得分经逐用户min-max归一化作为参与度信号。(3) **碳感知重排序**：对归一化的相关性得分和PCF进行线性标量化，即 s_{ui}=(1-λ)·ỹ_{ui} - λ·PCF̃_i，λ∈[0,1]为透明度高的单一策略杠杆。评估采用NDCG@10衡量参与度、AvgPCF@10（kg CO₂e）衡量碳影响，扫描25点λ网格构建Pareto前沿。实验在Amazon Reviews数据集的Home & Kitchen、Sports & Outdoors、Electronics三个类别上离线进行（K=100候选池），候选生成数据规模约为63K-110K用户、24K物品、535K-1.04M交互。
AI.result: PCF估计方面，少样本LLM在消费级基准（n=771，PCF真实值≤10,000 kg CO₂e）上取得最低RMSE（1,708.6）、MAE（695.1）和中位绝对误差（58.6），但Spearman秩相关（0.518）低于近邻平均（0.728）；零样本LLM秩相关仅0.064。重排序呈现典型的"平台期+陡降"模式：在5% NDCG预算下，BPR和LightGCN在三个类别上普遍可实现70-86%的碳减排；NeuMF基线参与度最高但灵活性最差，Electronics类别下仅7.6%减排即突破5% NDCG门槛，但Home & Kitchen上可超过80%。类别层面，Home & Kitchen最具碳弹性（三种模型均>80%），Electronics最受限，Sports & Outdoors居中。模型层面，NeuMF基线NDCG最高但分数分布更尖锐，对重排序扰动更敏感；BPR在Electronics和Home & Kitchen领先，LightGCN在Sports & Outdoors领先。结论强调：可持续性推荐不仅是重排序问题，也是模型选择和类别结构问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，即使在PCF标签需推断而非观测的不确定条件下，基于检索增强的PCF估计与可审计的后置重排序仍可显著降低推荐商品的碳足迹，且在多数情况下NDCG@10仅出现有限下降。λ作为显式可调策略杠杆，使系统在无需重新训练基础模型的前提下，将可持续性目标透明、可审计地嵌入推荐流程，并契合算法问责的监管预期。但碳减排空间因模型架构与商品类别结构而显著异质：分数分布更平滑、替代品更丰富的组合（如BPR/LightGCN × Home & Kitchen）暴露更大碳头空间，而分数尖锐或替代品稀缺的组合（如NeuMF × Electronics）则很快触及参与度悬崖。研究局限包括：依赖观察性评论数据固有的选择与曝光偏差、PCF估计误差向下游传播、离线评估无法捕捉真实行为响应、候选池大小（K=100）可能限制低碳替代品暴露。未来工作应拓展至在线A/B测试、丰富的浏览/购买行为数据、结构化供应链数据改进PCF估计、候选池规模敏感性分析，以及将碳目标内嵌至训练阶段以替代后置重排序等方向。

title: Improving the Efficiency and Effectiveness of LLM Knowledge Distillation for Conversational Search
comment: SCAI Workshop at SIGIR '26}{July 20--24, 2026}{Melbourne, Naarm, Australia
summary: Conversational Search (CS) considers retrieval of relevant documents based on conversational context. Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly enhanced CS by enabling effective query rewriting. However, employing LLMs during inference poses efficiency challenges. A method to balance effectiveness and efficiency is the use of knowledge distillation from LLM-based query rewriting. Recent work applies the Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD) for distillation, relaxing the alignment with the teacher signal compared to previous methods. Despite these gains, several aspects of KLD-based distillation for conversational search remain understudied, and we investigate them in this work. Prior work in related fields suggests that adding a contrastive loss to the KLD objective can improve performance; we confirm this and observe significant gains in precision-oriented ranking metrics. We also find that contrastive sampling strategies for the KLD loss have a non-trivial impact and must be chosen carefully. Although theory suggests that more samples improve the KLD estimate, experiments show diminishing returns on the number of used samples. Finally, we address the phenomenon of decreased sparsity in longer conversations, which limits computational efficiency across sparse retrieval methods. We find that the representations from the model distilled with the KLD loss can be strongly regularized with a regularization loss, substantially improving sparsity and inference efficiency without significantly harming retrieval effectiveness. We achieve a $2\times$ decrease in FLOPS on TopiOCQA with negligible loss in effectiveness, corresponding to a $\leq 2%$ drop in Recall@100. Our results provide insights into distillation objectives for learned sparse conversational retrievers and offer practical guidelines for improving effectiveness and efficiency in first-stage retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文针对对话检索（CS）中基于KLD的知识蒸馏方法（DiSCo）进行系统性研究，提出三项改进：在KLD损失中加入加权InfoNCE对比损失以提升排序指标精度；分析正负样本采样比例对性能的影响；以及增大正则化强度以显著提升推理稀疏度与效率。
AI.motivation: LLM查询重写在对话检索中效果好但推理成本高。现有DiSCo方法使用KLD进行知识蒸馏，但KLD损失作为分布对齐目标，无法精细控制对比学习强度；采样策略对正样本的代表性影响未被充分研究；且长对话场景下稀疏性下降、推理效率受损的问题仍待解决。
AI.method: （1）提出加权组合损失：Loss = λ·InfoNCE_sim + (1-λ)·KLD，通过λ∈[0,1]平衡蒸馏与对比目标；（2）从理论分析KLD作为期望估计的采样影响，结合大数定律与重要性采样分析增加样本的效果；（3）应用L1正则化（query）和FLOPS正则化（document），设置5个不同强度等级，考察在TopiOCQA数据集上基于SPLADE++的DiSCo实现效果。
AI.result: （1）加入10%-20% InfoNCE显著提升MRR与nDCG@3（MRR从0.409提升至0.421-0.424），Recall@100仅有轻微不显著下降；（2）采样16个负样本效果最佳，更多样本（32、70）反而因正样本被稀释导致性能下降，尽管KLD值更低但下游性能不再提升；（3）"Higher"正则化设置下FLOPS降低2倍（从3.79降至1.37），Recall@100仅下降≤2%，且在长对话场景中显著改善稀疏性。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了KLD蒸馏中结合对比损失、谨慎选择采样数量以及加大正则化是平衡对话检索效率与有效性的有效途径，为学习型稀疏对话检索器的蒸馏目标设计提供了实用指导原则。

title: EviRank: Evidence-Based Confidence Estimation for LLM-Based Ranking
summary: Large Language Models show promise for recommendation, but they raise reliability concerns due to limited domain coverage and inherent stochasticity. Existing uncertainty quantification methods persist two fundamental challenges: (1) the global confidence score designed for question answering fails to reveal which positions are unreliable in ranking list; (2) fine-grained confidence extracted from model internals exhibits uniformly low values across all positions, making it impossible to filter unreliable predictions. To tackle the challenges, we propose an evidence-based confidence estimation for LLM-based ranking (EviRank). We extract three complementary evidences from a single forward pass and aggregate them via reliable opinion aggregation. Furthermore, we recognize that ranking positions are inherently unequal, and introduce a position-aware calibration. Lastly, the calibrated confidence guides ranking optimization. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both recommendation and uncertainty quantification.

AI.tldr: EviRank提出了一种基于证据的位置级置信度估计方法，用于LLM排序任务。通过单次前向传播提取语义、注意力、输出三类证据，利用主观逻辑中的可靠意见聚合融合证据，并引入位置感知校准解决现有方法校准偏差问题，最终通过置信度引导的重排序优化推荐性能。
AI.motivation: LLM在推荐系统中展现出潜力，但存在两个可靠性问题：(1) 现有全局置信度评分（来自问答场景）无法揭示排序列表中哪些位置不可靠；(2) 从模型内部提取的细粒度置信度在所有位置上都呈现均匀低值，无法有效过滤不可靠预测。因此需要一种能够为排序任务提供位置级可靠置信度的方法。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) **证据提取**：从单次前向传播中提取三类互补证据——语义证据（基于隐藏状态与用户偏好的余弦相似度差异）、注意力证据（基于归一化注意力熵）、输出证据（基于相邻位置最大概率差异）；(2) **可靠意见聚合**：基于主观逻辑框架将证据转化为Dirichlet参数和信念质量，通过可靠系数（基于不确定性质量）自适应加权融合多源证据，证明该融合算子满足交换律和结合律；(3) **位置感知校准**：利用NDCG折扣因子（Np=1/log2(p+1)）编码位置重要性，通过sigmoid函数和可学习参数校准原始信念质量，监督目标为校准置信度与位置重要性目标的均方误差；(4) **置信度引导重排序**：将校准后的置信度与LLM原始logits softmax得分相乘构成最终评分函数，用BPR损失优化排序。
AI.result: 在MovieLens 1M、Amazon Grocery、Steam三个数据集上，使用Mistral、Llama3、Qwen2.5三个LLM骨干网络进行实验。结果显示：(1) 推荐性能：EviRank在所有数据集和骨干网络上均达到最优，例如Qwen2.5在MovieLens 1M上R@5达到0.5702，N@20达到0.6018，显著优于LLM4Rerank基线；(2) 不确定性量化：τ@5和C@5指标在大多数设置下也达到最优，例如Qwen2.5在Amazon Grocery上τ@5达到0.2661，C@5达到0.6739；(3) 消融实验证明三个证据源、可靠意见聚合、位置感知校准均不可或缺，注意力证据贡献最大；(4) 推理时间（9864ms）低于LLM4Rerank（12339ms），因所有证据从单次前向传播提取。
AI.conclusion: EviRank通过基于证据的位置级置信度估计同时提升了推荐质量和不确定性量化能力。位置感知校准有效解决了现有方法的校准偏差问题，恢复了置信度与位置重要性之间的相关性。基于NDCG折扣目标的排序自适应校准目标比传统基于分箱的分类校准更适合排序任务。未来工作将探索冷启动场景下的置信度估计。

title: Dual-Stream MLP is All You Need for CTR Prediction
summary: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction holds a pivotal role in online advertising and recommendation systems, where even small improvements can significantly boost revenue. Existing research primarily focuses on designing dual-stream architectures to capture effective complex feature interactions from both explicit and implicit perspectives. However, these approaches are faced with two major challenges: 1) the high complexity of feature interaction learning, which increases computational demands and the overfitting risk, and 2) the imbalance between explicit and implicit modules, where one module's output may dominate the final prediction. To address these issues, in this paper, we propose Dual-Stream MLP (DS-MLP), a novel feature interaction framework for the CTR prediction task. Specially, it leverages knowledge distillation to consolidate the capacity of learning explicit feature interaction into a main MLP network, while a parallel MLP simultaneously captures implicit feature interactions as a complement. To effectively optimize the dual-stream MLP architecture, we further design a specific learning approach with two alignment strategies for enhancing the compatibility of the two MLP components. Experiments demonstrate that DS-MLP, though merely a vanilla MLP structure (the final model), can achieve state-of-the-art performance across three widely used benchmarks, offering a scalable and efficient solution for large-scale recommendation systems. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了用于CTR预测的双流MLP框架DS-MLP。该框架通过知识蒸馏将复杂教师模型（如GDCN）的显式特征交互能力迁移到主MLP中,并引入并行的辅助MLP学习隐式特征交互,结合隐藏状态对齐（BN）和预测对齐（双分支监督损失）两种策略,缓解显隐式模块不均衡问题。最终仅用纯MLP结构在Criteo、Avazu、MovieLens三个基准上达到SOTA性能,并保持低推理延迟和良好的可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有CTR预测中的双流架构存在两个关键缺陷:(1)显式特征交互学习的高复杂度导致计算开销大且过拟合风险高;(2)显式与隐式模块融合时存在输出数值范围不一致的"不均衡融合"问题,显式分支（如Hadamard积产生的指数级增长输出）会主导最终预测,使隐式分支失效。因此需要一种既能保持强表达能力又结构简单、且两个分支能有效协同的CTR模型。
AI.method:
DS-MLP采用两阶段优化流程:蒸馏→对齐→整体优化。
**阶段一(知识蒸馏)**:以GDCN等强教师模型的logits为软标签,通过KL散度损失训练3层主MLP,使其内化教师模型的显式特征交叉能力。
**阶段二(双MLP微调)**:引入并行MLP(从零学习,捕获隐式交互)与主MLP协同,采用两种对齐策略:(a) 隐藏状态对齐——对两分支隐藏层施加Batch Normalization,使输出数值范围可比;(b) 预测对齐——对两分支分别施加BCE任务损失,使其作为独立预测器相互兼容。
最终预测为两分支logits均值经sigmoid输出。理论上基于通用近似定理和Hessian对齐证明ReLU MLP可恢复交叉网络编码的显式高阶交互。模型具有teacher-agnostic、纯MLP骨干、易于扩展和部署友好的特点。
AI.result: 在Criteo、Avazu、MovieLens三个公开基准上均取得SOTA,AUC分别为0.8152、0.7670、0.9752,RelaImpr达3.21%、2.73%、6.02%。兼容性实验表明DS-MLP可与AutoInt、DCNv2、xDeepFM、GDCN、FinalMLP等异构教师模型无缝结合,均带来稳定提升。可扩展性方面,随参数量增加DS-MLP性能单调提升,而GDCN则饱和甚至下降。消融实验验证了主MLP、并联MLP、对齐损失、KD四个组件的必要性。保真度分析显示学生MLP的MSE与教师CrossNet模块一致收敛,有效内化了显式交互;案例研究证明并联MLP可纠正教师的预测偏差。推理延迟与FinalMLP、DCNv2等轻量模型相当,适合工业部署。
AI.conclusion: DS-MLP以"简单即强大"的设计理念,证明了纯MLP结构通过知识蒸馏+双流对齐即可同时高效建模显式和隐式特征交互,在性能、效率和可扩展性三方面取得良好平衡,为大规模CTR预测提供了一个实用且通用的解决方案。未来工作方向包括扩展为多流MoE架构,以及自适应确定MLP深度/宽度和双流贡献权重的动态平衡策略。

title: SearchLog: A Web Browser Extension for Capturing Search Logs in Laboratory Studies
summary: Natural search logs are valuable for studying search behavior in information seeking settings. We present SearchLog, an easy-to-install web browser extension for collecting natural search logs during lab-based studies. SearchLog allows participants to search the open web using a browser while recording structured interaction data across mouse, keyboard, search activity, and browser state modules. The extension captures clicks, scrolling, hovered text, typed words, search queries, result rankings, AI-generated summaries when available, tab activity, and window changes. A local Flask backend stores each session as an ordered JSON event stream, with HTML snapshots and preprocessed search result data for later analysis. These logs can be used to derive measures such as query reformulation, page visits, dwell time, scroll behavior, tab switching, search path complexity, and exposure to AI-generated search content. By supporting natural browser-based search with structured experimental metadata, SearchLog provides a reusable resource to study search behavior across traditional and AI-enhanced search interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SearchLog，一款基于Chromium浏览器的扩展工具，用于在实验室研究中采集参与者在开放网页上自然搜索行为的多模态结构化日志。该工具通过本地Flask后端存储JSON事件流、HTML快照和搜索结果排名，支持研究传统及AI增强搜索界面下的用户搜索行为。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索日志采集方法（如自定义脚本、屏幕录制、受控搜索界面等）往往需要专业技术能力、繁琐的后处理流程，且无法完全反映用户在开放网络上的自然搜索行为。随着搜索引擎引入AI生成摘要（如Google AI Overviews、Bing Copilot），传统的查询-点击-URL日志已不足以捕捉完整的搜索体验。此外，现有浏览器日志工具功能覆盖有限，缺乏对鼠标移动、悬停文本、AI摘要等细粒度交互的全面记录，亟需一个易安装、可复用的结构化日志采集工具。
AI.method: SearchLog采用客户端-服务器架构。客户端是基于Manifest V3的Chromium浏览器扩展，通过JavaScript事件监听器（捕获鼠标、键盘、滚动、悬停、点击等交互）和DOM解析脚本（提取搜索结果排名、AI生成摘要）在页面级别采集数据；浏览器级别数据（标签页、窗口操作）通过浏览器API采集。数据组织为四个模块：鼠标、键盘、搜索活动、浏览器状态。服务器端使用Flask实现本地后端，提供会话启动、停止和数据接收的端点，每个会话以唯一ID存储在独立文件夹中，包含有序的JSON事件流、HTML快照和预处理的搜索结果排名JSON文件。目前支持Google和Bing两款搜索引擎及其AI摘要（AI Overviews、AI Mode对话、Copilot Search）。会话生命周期分为四步：会话启动、日志记录、会话结束、生成分析产物。隐私保护方面，密码输入字段会被遮蔽。
AI.result: 通过六类技术验证场景（基础搜索、多标签搜索、鼠标交互、键盘输入、AI摘要捕获、会话边界处理）进行功能验证。结果表明：会话控制正确启停；鼠标移动以起止坐标记录；滚动捕获起止位置；悬停文本可识别；键盘按键按时间窗口分组记录且命令（选择、复制粘贴）被识别；密码字段被正确遮蔽；Google和Bing的搜索事件、HTML快照、搜索排名和AI摘要均被正确保存并与页面内容一致；标签页和窗口的开/关/聚焦/加载事件被准确捕获。通过与Search-Logger、SearchPanel、SearchBar、OrgBox、TrackThinkTS、LogUI等工具的比较，SearchLog在功能覆盖上最为全面。
AI.conclusion: SearchLog以Apache 2.0许可证发布，提供了完整的浏览器扩展、本地Flask后端、文档及非敏感示例日志。其核心价值在于：支持实验室环境下开放网络的自然搜索行为采集；以结构化日志模式组织数据；特别适用于研究传统和AI增强搜索界面下的用户行为。未来工作将扩展对Firefox/Safari的支持，增加更多搜索引擎（DuckDuckGo、Yahoo!、Baidu、Yandex等），并扩展对ChatGPT、Copilot、Gemini、Claude等LLM系统的交互日志记录。

title: PRECISE: Reducing the Bias of LLM Evaluations Using Prediction-Powered Ranking Estimation
comment: Accepted at AAAI 2026 - Innovative Applications of AI (IAAI-26)
summary: Evaluating the quality of search, ranking and RAG systems traditionally requires a significant number of human relevance annotations. In recent times, several deployed systems have explored the usage of Large Language Models (LLMs) as automated judges for this task while their inherent biases prevent direct use for metric estimation. We present a statistical framework extending Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) that combines minimal human annotations with LLM judgments to produce reliable estimates of metrics which require sub-instance annotations. Our method requires as few as 100 human-annotated queries and 10,000 unlabeled examples, reducing annotation requirements significantly compared to traditional approaches. We formulate our proposed framework (PRECISE) for inference of relevance uplift for an LLM-based query reformulation application, extending PPI to sub-instance annotations at the query-document level. By reformulating the metric-integration space, we reduced the computational complexity from O(2^|C|) to O(2^K), where |C| represents corpus size (in order of millions). Detailed experiments across prominent retrieval datasets demonstrate that our method reduces the variance of estimates for the business-critical Precision@K metric, while effectively correcting for LLM bias in low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: PRECISE 是一个扩展 Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) 的统计框架，用于解决搜索/排序系统评估中 LLM 评判的偏差问题。该方法将少量人工标注（最少 100 个查询）与大量 LLM 标注相结合，通过将稀疏 K-hot 向量与排序级分解相结合，将计算复杂度从 O(2^|C|) 降低到 O(2^K)，在低资源场景下实现对 Precision@K 等关键指标的无偏估计。
AI.motivation: 搜索和排序系统的评估传统上依赖大量人工相关性标注，成本高且难以扩展；虽然使用 LLM 作为自动评判者可以提高效率，但 LLM 固有的偏差（如位置偏差、上下文偏差等）使其无法直接用于精确指标估计。现有 PPI 框架假设标注粒度与评估粒度一致（实例级别），但排序指标的评估存在粒度不匹配问题：人工标注在 (query, document) 原子级别，而 Precision@K 等指标在 query 级别计算，这使得 vanilla PPI 估计器不可行。此外，LLM 输出的概率分布在整个语料库（百万级）上积分会产生不可承受的计算复杂度。
AI.method: PRECISE 的核心创新在于将 PPI 框架扩展到子实例（子查询级别）标注场景。方法上：（1）将排序模型输出表示为 K-hot 向量（仅 K 个相关文档为"热"），将真实标注也表示为稀疏向量；（2）利用 Precision@K 的稀疏性，将输出空间 Y 从 {0,1}^|C|（语料库大小，百万级）缩减为 {0,1}^K（通常 K≤10），通过乘积分布公式计算 K 长度二元向量的概率；（3）采用 PPI++ 估计器 μ̂_PPI++ = λ·(1/N)Σμ̃_u + (1/n)Σ[φ(f(x_g),y_g) - λ·μ̃_g]，其中 λ∈[0,1] 为可调超参数；（4）使用 Claude 3 Sonnet/Haiku 等 LLM 作为自动评判者，通过提示工程引出不确定性级别（"About Even"到"Almost Certain"）并映射到 [0.5, 1.0] 区间，再利用标注集上的等渗回归（isotonic regression）进行校准。
AI.result: 在 ESCI 公开数据集和印度电商生产数据集上的实验表明：（1）PRECISE-PPI 即使在 n=30 的人工标注下也能显著降低估计方差，且比纯 LLM 估计（prob 和 bin 方法）偏差小得多；（2）100 倍无标注数据（3,000 查询）即可达到接近 2,000 倍数据（60,000 查询）的性能，成本降低 95%；（3）Claude 3 Haiku 在性能上接近 Sonnet（偏差 0.29 vs 0.70），但成本仅为后者的 1/12（$79 vs $946）；（4）校准质量直接影响 PPI 性能，LLM 评判者（Claude 系列）校准良好，交叉编码器（Jina Turbo）校准较差；（5）成功应用于印度电商的 Hinglish 查询改写系统部署：Treatment 1（基础翻译纠错）被正确预测为最佳方案，部署后 BAU 日销售额提升 407bps，CTR 提升 571bps，浏览深度提升 782bps，并已扩展到更多查询类型。
AI.conclusion: PRECISE 框架证明了通过结合少量人工标注与大量 LLM 标注，能够在显著降低人工标注负担（仅需 100 个查询）的同时，对排序系统进行可靠的指标估计并有效修正 LLM 偏差。该方法在生产环境中得到验证，展示了 PPI 风格估计在现实工业场景中的实用价值，为大规模信息检索系统的高效、可扩展评估开辟了新途径。未来工作方向包括：使用 LLM 生成的"银标"数据、动态语料库更新、多轮对话/多模态检索、多 LLM 集成评估以及在线评估场景的扩展。

title: Pinning on Tight Cuts: Improved Algorithm and Bounds for Unsplittable Multicommodity Flows in Outerplanar Graphs
summary: The multicommodity flow problem in an undirected capacitated graph $G$ is specified by a set of source-sink pairs with nonnegative demands. A flow is feasible if it routes all demands without exceeding the edge capacities, and it is unsplittable if it routes each demand along a single path. Let $\alpha$ be the smallest value such that the existence of a feasible flow implies the existence of an unsplittable flow that exceeds the edge capacities by at most $+\,\alpha\,d_{\max}$, where $d_{\max}$ is the maximum demand value. Schrijver, Seymour, and Winkler showed that $\alpha\in\left[1.01,\,1.5\right]$ if $G$ is a cycle. These bounds were ultimately improved to $\alpha\in\left[1.1,\,1.3\right]$ by Skutella and Däubel. Recently, Alemán Espinosa and Kumar extended this constant upper bound to the broader class of outerplanar graphs, and showed that if $G$ is outerplanar then $\alpha\le 3.6$. We show that $\alpha\in\left[\tfrac{4}{3},2\right]$ if $G$ is outerplanar. We introduce a novel technique that considers the global parameters of the instance, and that may be useful in other (more general) settings where the cut-condition is sufficient, or nearly sufficient, for the existence of a feasible flow.

AI.tldr: 本文研究外平面图上不可分多商品流问题，证明了在存在可行分数流的条件下，必然存在不可分流使其容量超出量被限制在 +2d_max 以内（之前上界为 3.6d_max）。同时，作者构造了外平面图实例，证明了 +4/3 d_max 的下界，从而将外平面图与环加载问题区分开来。核心技术创新是"在紧切割上钉扎"（pinning on tight cuts）方法——通过紧切割将外平面实例递归分解为更小的"切割实例"和"分割实例"。
AI.motivation: 不可分多商品流是一个NP困难问题，但实际应用常要求每条需求沿单一路径路由。已有研究在特殊图类（如环/圈）上取得了常数上界。外平面图是比环更广泛且仍满足切割条件充分性的图类。之前Alemán Espinosa与Kumar证明了 α_O ≤ 3.6 的上界，本文旨在显著改进这一界，并探索在更一般设置中"切割条件充分或近似充分"时可推广的技术。
AI.method: 技术核心是"在紧切割上钉扎"：(1)定义"x-友好"中心集S（x-流将H[S]内需求完全路由在G[S]内）；(2)对紧切割δ_G(S)，构造两个更小子实例——切割实例I^cut（移除G[S]内部边，将剩余容量转移到外路径）和分割实例I^split（在G[S]内用G^flow路由残余需求）；(3)递归求解两个子实例后合并得到原实例的不可分流；(4)使用环加载的Schrijver-Seymour-Winkler引理（对指定单边提供1/2上界）作为基础工具。证明采用最小反例论证，按内边数和需求数做字典序归纳。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 定理1.1——上界 α_O ≤ 2，即任何外平面图上的可行实例都存在不可分流，每边容量超出不超过 2d_max，且可在多项式时间内计算；(2) 定理1.2——下界 α_O ≥ 4/3，通过构造由4个一维网格附加到中心12环组成的实例，参数化为n后渐近达到 4/3；(3) 附带推论：α_O ≠ α_RL，证明外平面图严格难于环加载问题；(4) 对环加载的引理3.1和引理3.2（对两个预先指定边提供1/2上界）的新证明。
AI.conclusion: 本文将外平面图上不可分多商品流的容量违反常数从3.6改进到2（接近环加载的1.3），并通过紧切割上的钉扎技术建立了一种新的分治框架。这种全局处理实例参数的方法具有良好推广性，尤其有望应用于更复杂的Okamura-Seymour设置。下界4/3与上界2之间仍存在间隙，是后续研究的核心开放问题。

title: Independence and Domination on Bounded-Treewidth Graphs: Integer, Rational, and Irrational Distances
summary: The distance-d variants of Independent Set and Dominating Set problems have been extensively studied from different algorithmic viewpoints. In particular, the complexity of these problems are well understood on bounded-treewidth graphs [Katsikarelis, Lampis, and Paschos, Discret. Appl. Math 2022][Borradaile and Le, IPEC 2016]: given a tree decomposition of width t, the two problems can be solved in time $d^t \cdot n^{O(1)}$ and $(2d + 1)t \cdot n^{O(1)}$, respectively. Furthermore, assuming the Strong Exponential-Time Hypothesis (SETH), the base constants are best possible in these running times: they cannot be improved to $d-{\epsilon}$ and $2d+1-{\epsilon}$, respectively, for any ${\epsilon} > 0$. We investigate continuous versions of these problems in a setting introduced by Megiddo and Tamir [SICOMP 1983], where every edge is modeled by a unit-length interval of points. In the {\delta}-Dispersion problem, the task is to find a maximum number of points (possibly inside edges) that are pairwise at distance at least {\delta} from each other. Similarly, in the {\delta}-Covering problem, the task is to find a minimum number of points (possibly inside edges) such that every point of the graph (including those inside edges) is at distance at most {\delta} from the selected point set. We provide a comprehensive understanding of these two problems on bounded-treewidth graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了图上距离约束问题的"连续版本"（δ-Dispersion 和 δ-Covering），即允许点位于边的内部（每条边建模为单位长度区间），并在 bounded-treewidth 图上给出了系统性的算法与复杂度分析。
AI.motivation: 经典的 distance-d Independent Set 与 Dominating Set 在 bounded-treewidth 图上已有较成熟的算法（运行时间分别为 d^t·n^{O(1)} 和 (2d+1)t·n^{O(1)}），且在 SETH 假设下常数最优。然而 Megiddo & Tamir (1983) 提出的"连续版本"——点可放置在边内部——尚未在 bounded-treewidth 图上得到系统研究，作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 研究对象为两类连续优化问题：(1) δ-Dispersion：在图中选择尽可能多的点（可位于边上）使其两两距离 ≥ δ；(2) δ-Covering：选择尽可能少的点（可位于边上）使得图中所有点（包括边上点）到所选点集的距离 ≤ δ。基于 tree decomposition 宽度 t 设计参数化算法，并结合 SETH 给出匹配的紧下界。
AI.result: 从摘要所述，作者对 bounded-treewidth 图上的 δ-Dispersion 与 δ-Covering 给出了"comprehensive understanding"，即同时提供了（接近）最优的运行时间上界与 SETH 条件下的匹配下界，与离散版本 d^t·n^{O(1)} / (2d+1)t·n^{O(1)} 的最优性形成完整对应。
AI.conclusion: 论文将经典组合优化问题的连续对应物在 bounded-treewidth 图上完整刻画，建立了与离散情形相对应的算法-复杂度二分图，证实了在连续几何设置下基本参数 d 的指数依赖同样本质。

title: Randomization for Faster Exact Optimization of Discounted Markov Decision Processes
summary: We provide faster deterministic and randomized algorithms for exactly solving discounted Markov Decision Processes (DMDPs). We obtain our results by efficiently reducing computing optimal values and policies in DMDPs to the easier tasks of policy evaluation and computing approximately optimal values in DMDPs. We provide both a straightforward deterministic reduction and a more efficient randomized variant that, together with advances in approximately solving DMDPs, yield our results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将折扣马尔可夫决策过程（DMDP）的精确求解归约为策略评估和近似求解的通用框架，并基于此设计了确定性算法和更快的随机化算法，在多种参数体系下均超越了现有最优结果。
AI.motivation: 折扣马尔可夫决策过程（γ-DMDP）的精确求解是强化学习和运筹学的基础问题。虽然近似求解已有大量研究，但精确求解的进展相对有限。Ye (2005) 的组合内点法（IPM）提供了 $O(\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{tot}}^4 \log\frac{\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{tot}}}{1-\gamma})$ 的运行时间，但该方法强依赖于特定的IPM技术。本文旨在通过将精确求解归约为更简单的策略评估和近似求解任务，去除对特定IPM的依赖，并利用随机化进一步加速求解。
AI.method: 核心方法是一个迭代剔除次优动作的框架（Algorithm 1）：1) 维护一个γ-DMDP，逐步剔除不属于任何最优策略的动作；2) 在每次迭代中，选择一个策略π，调用MultValApprox子程序计算关于π次优性的ε-最优值；3) 通过奖励平移技术（shifted MDP）将近似求解器以与策略次优性成比例的精度运行，避免∥r∥∞/∥v_π - v*∥∞比值过大的问题；4) 利用优势函数（advantage function）Δ(v)_{s,a}的负值检测可剔除的次优动作。对于随机化版本，每轮均匀随机选择策略π，通过势函数Φ(M) = |Π(M)|的期望衰减分析（Lemma 4.1），证明每次迭代Φ期望减半，从而将迭代次数从O(A_tot)降至Õ(S_tot)。此外还提出了一个随机化策略迭代算法（Algorithm 2）。
AI.result: 确定性归约（Theorem 1.2）实现了 O(S_tot^ω A_tot + S_tot A_tot^2) + O(A_tot) · T_Det 的运行时间。随机化归约（Theorem 1.4）通过将迭代次数降为Õ(S_tot)，在每个状态有足够多动作时获得额外Õ(A_tot/S_tot)因子加速。具体结果包括：使用Bellman值迭代得到 O((S^ω A + S A²/(1-γ)) log(1/(1-γ)))，使用vdB (2020)的IPM得到 Õ(A^(ω_curr+1) log(1/(1-γ)))，使用采样值迭代（SWWY 2023; JKSW 2024, 2025）得到 Õ(S^ω+1 + (S²A + S^1.5 A/(1-γ)) log^O(1)(1/(1-γ))) 的期望时间。随机化策略迭代（Corollary 5.2）实现 Õ((S^(ω+1) + S²A)/(1-γ) · log(1/(1-γ))) 时间。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个简洁、模块化的框架，将精确γ-DMDP求解黑箱归约为策略评估和近似求解，摆脱了对特定内点法的依赖。随机化技术的引入通过势函数分析显著减少了迭代次数，在多种参数体系下改进了先前最优结果。该框架还揭示了精确求解与近似求解之间更深层的联系，并为随机化策略迭代变体的进一步分析开辟了方向。
